# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Kernel chain: cadorange → occt.ts | Modeling goes through **[cadorange](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/cadorange)** (the agent-native CAD runtime wrapping the occt.ts/OCCT WASM; public API + the supported `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for meshing/HLR/wire construction); the direct occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier — `DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one explicitly (the opencascade.js tier was removed in v0.15.1, −64MB install). The old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🌗 Dark-mode surfaces | Every rendered surface follows the host theme — viewport slab, DXF/drawing strokes, the Three.js grid / XYZ triad / feature edges / default mesh color / sketch overlays, and the ViewCube plate; a theme flip restyles mounted viewers live. Overrides: `--dsh-cad-bg`, `--dsh-cad-stroke`, `--dsh-cad-paper` |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation. `cad_loft` sections accept **curves** too: point loops, `{through}` splines or planar `{profile}` chains; `smooth: true` fits a **periodic B-spline** through point loops — one continuous B-spline lateral face instead of planar strips meeting at G0 creases |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 🔩 Joint-driven assemblies | The build123d joint family (rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar): `cad_assembly_joint` defines, `cad_assembly_connect` pairs-and-solves (parent fixed, child repositioned onto the joint frames), `cad_assembly_drive` drives motion values with cascading re-solve (motion studies), `cad_assembly_explode` for exploded views; the assembly-tree panel gains a JOINTS section (kind/current value/pairing link). Pure main-thread placement algebra — kernel-independent, replays from the op log |
| 📥 STEP assembly import | `cad_step_import` imports a STEP document as an assembly: names, nesting and instance placements survive, identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances (a bolt pattern is one body); files cache as content-addressed workspace assets so op-log replay stays self-contained (cadorange kernel) |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling. A host-independent liveness poll (`GET /dsh-cad/docs` → per-document op count) keeps the viewport following modeling ops even when the conversation meta pipeline goes stale, and auto-returns from a file preview |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane, or a curve/`profile` section); sections may differ in shape and point count; `smooth` fits a periodic B-spline through point loops for a **crease-free** skin; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_assembly_joint` | Define a joint on an instance (build123d family: rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar), frame in the instance's local coordinates |
| `cad_assembly_connect` | Pair joints to place a child: the parent stays fixed, the child is repositioned so both joint frames coincide (optional connect-time drive value) |
| `cad_assembly_drive` | Drive a joint's motion value and re-solve every pairing (one motion-study step; ranges enforced) |
| `cad_assembly_solve` | Re-solve all pairings at current joint values (after moving a parent manually) |
| `cad_assembly_explode` | Exploded-view factor (instances push radially from the assembly center; view-state only, exports/drawings stay assembled) |
| `cad_assembly_info` | Read the assembly state: placements + joint labels/types/values + pairings + explode factor |
| `cad_step_import` | Structured STEP import: names, part structure and placements survive; identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling runs on the **occt.ts kernel** via cadorange (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (occt.ts WASM via cadorange)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (cadorange over the occt.ts wasm) are separate, both lazily started
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. Kernel APIs: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Kernel chain**: modeling goes through **cadorange** (agent-native CAD
  runtime; public build123d-style API for prims/curve-segment profiles (TRUE
  B-spline interpolation)/loft/sweep/revolve/booleans (cleaned by default)/
  fillet/chamfer/shell/draft/native mirror/centroid, plus the supported
  `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for viewer tessellation, engineering-drawing
  HLR (zero STEP hops, one wasm session) and wire construction); the direct
  occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier (`DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one; see
  docs/cadorange-integration.md for the verb-by-verb mapping). Editing after
  shelling is seamless. Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document**
  (cadorange
  `exportStepAssembly`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Theming (dark mode)

The viewer follows the host appearance automatically. DSH publishes the theme as
`color-scheme` on `<html>` plus `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; the plugin resolves
that (falling back to `prefers-color-scheme`) and themes every surface the host
tokens cannot reach:

- the viewport slab behind the transparent WebGL canvas and 2D scenes,
- default 2D entity strokes (DXF / engineering-drawing entities),
- the Three.js ground grid, XYZ axis triad/labels, feature edges, default mesh
  color and sketch overlays,
- the ViewCube face plate (canvas texture).

A theme flip restyles mounted cards and the resident panel live — no reload and
no lost camera. Engineering drawings loaded as SVG keep a white sheet; in dark
mode it is framed as paper on the dark slab instead of filling the viewport.

Hosts can override the surfaces the plugin owns; an explicit definition wins in
either theme:

| CSS variable | Applies to | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dsh-cad-bg` | viewport background (any CSS `background` value) | light `#f5f6f8→#e9ecf0`, dark `#1b1b1c→#151517` |
| `--dsh-cad-stroke` | default 2D entity stroke | `#4c5561` light / `#c8ced6` dark |
| `--dsh-cad-paper` | drawing paper behind SVG sheets | `#ffffff` |

```css
:root { --dsh-cad-bg: #0b0d10; }          /* flat canvas in both themes */
```

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-po DeepSeek Harness 破甲插件：全部通过官方 cordis 插件 API 实现 —— 不改写任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包源码，不做 asar 抽取、不做字符串替换补丁。 ## 为什么不需要破解 逆向官方 DSH 0.2.x 包后发现：破甲想达到的效果，官方插件 API 本身就覆盖了： | 能力 | 目标 | 实现 | |---|---|---| | 沙箱模式 | 默认 `danger-full-access` | `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖 `sandbox-policy.mode` | | 文件写放行 | 写入不再被沙箱拒绝 | 不需要：官方 `dsh-bash-sandbox` / `dsh-fs-sandbox` 在 `danger-full-access` 下直接 unfenced/unconfined | | 审批策略 | 策略与模式组合 | `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖 `approval.policy: ask` | | 审批自动放行 | 审批门自动放行 | 运行时 `ctx.on("approval/request", () => "allowed-once")` 应答器 | | 审批默认 | 默认 `never` | 同上，改为 `ask` 走应答器 | | 放行句 | 模型可见「自动放行」句 | `systemPrompt.context()` 在 order 116 追加覆盖句 | | 身份剥离 | 去掉官方身份/人设 | `system-prompt` 配置 `includeHarnessIdentity:false` + `personaPrefix/Suffix:""` | | 破甲提示词 | 注入正文 | `systemPrompt.section()`（`interpolate:false`，order -100000） | | 扩展：结果截断 | `spill-policy` 12500 tokens / `tool-result-pruner` 8192 chars | patch 层阈值拉到 1e9，实际永不触发 | | 扩展：工作区指令上限 | `agent-instructions` maxBytes 65536 | patch 层拉到 64MB | | 扩展：会话全文搜索 | `session-query-sqlite` `openAt: never` | patch 层 `openAt: first-search` | > 以下限制**保留官方默认，不做覆盖**（应要求回退）： > - `timeout-policy`：工具调用 deadline > - `bash-sandbox` / `pwsh-sandbox`：执行超时 60s > - `tool-web`：`searchTimeoutMs` 60s > - `web-fetch-http`：全部上限（公网 unicast 防线、5MB / 100k 字符、30s、5 跳重定向、仅文本类型） > - `fs-observation-policy`：写前必须读 + CAS（本地文件安全限制） > workspace 指令 intro 重写是 `dsh-agent-instructions` 里的硬编码常量， > 官方 API 没有对应配置项。它的效果（抬高 workspace 指令权重）由本插件注入的 > `-100000` 高优先级正文近似覆盖；若仍需要原样改写，才回到源文件补丁。 ## 文件结构 ``` cordis.patch.yml bundle patch：纯 config 覆盖（不写源文件） lib/index.js 运行时 cordis 插件（approval 应答器 + systemPrompt 注入） lib/prompt-inject.md 默认破甲提示词 scripts/profile-insert.js 把本体行写进用户层 cordis.patch.yml scripts/ensure-profile-bundle.mjs postinstall bin/dsh-po.js 状态检查 CLI ``` ## 安装 ### 官方 npm 源（推荐） ```sh cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" # desktop: profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-po # 或 npm install dsh-po # 或让 dsh 自己解析包名 "$DSH" plugin --profile web add dsh-po ``` 装完补跑一次本体 insert（pnpm 11/12 默认跳过 postinstall）： ```sh node node_modules/dsh-po/scripts/ensure-profile-bundle.mjs ``` ### 本地路径安装 装进你实际打开的宿主 profile（web 与 desktop 分开装）： ```sh # 官方 dsh web DSH="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" "$DSH" plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-po # 官方 desktop EXE "$DSH" plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-po ``` 或 pnpm 直接装（在 profile 目录内，不是仓库根）： ```sh cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" # desktop: profiles/desktop pnpm add /path/to/dsh-po ``` ### pnpm 11/12 会跳过 postinstall（重要） `dsh plugin add` 与 `pnpm add` 都只是让 pnpm 装包。pnpm 11/12 对本地 link/tarball **默认不跑 build scripts**，所以自动写入本体 insert 的 `postinstall` 可能被跳过。 装完后补跑一次即可（`dsh plugin add` 已自动把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`）： ```sh cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" # desktop: profiles/desktop node node_modules/dsh-po/scripts/ensure-profile-bundle.mjs ``` 或用 pnpm 放行 build： ```sh pnpm approve-builds dsh-po ``` 该脚本会： 1. 把 `dsh-po` 追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`（幂等） 2. 在用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 写入本体 insert 行（幂等，自动处理全新 profile 的空列表 `[]`） **生效方式**：完全退出并重启 dsh 宿主即可。没有「Apply」按钮、没有补丁状态页， 因为没有任何磁盘文件被改写。 验证： ```sh "$DSH" --profile web --dump-config # 应看到 sandbox-policy.mode: danger-full-access、approval.policy: ask、includeHarnessIdentity: false node bin/dsh-po.js status # 或宿主内确认系统提示词已注入破甲正文、审批请求被自动放行 ``` ## 手动安装（无 dsh / pnpm） 1. 把本目录放到 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-po`（目录名与 `package.json.name` 一致） 2. 编辑 `$DSH_HOME/profiles//package.json`： - `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-po": "file:../../plugins/dsh-po"` - `dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾加 `"dsh-po"` 3. 编辑该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，追加本体 insert（见 `scripts/profile-insert.js` 的 `INSERT_BLOCK`） 4. 在 profile 目录跑 `pnpm install`，重启宿主 ## DeekSeek Harness上直接安装 ## 配置 本体行 config 支持： ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-po name: dsh-po inject: [systemPrompt, tools] config: enabled: true verbose: false prompt: "" # 留空则用 lib/prompt-inject.md approvalContext: true postPrompt: "" postPromptOrder: 9000 ``` ## 已验证（本机 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3） 在本机 `DeepSeek Harness.app`（0.2.1-rc.3，桌面版）的 CLI 上实际验证通过： ```sh DSH="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" "$DSH" plugin --profile web add /Users/tester/Desktop/CrackAgentForMac/outputs/dsh-po cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" node node_modules/dsh-po/scripts/ensure-profile-bundle.mjs "$DSH" --profile web --dump-config # 配置覆盖全部生效 "$DSH" --profile web --no-open # 启动无报错 ``` 启动日志（`verbose: true`）： ```text [dsh-po] approval/request answerer installed (allowed-once) [dsh-po] approval runtime context installed [dsh-po] prompt section installed (2686 bytes) ``` `--dump-config` 确认 bundle patch 覆盖已生效：`sandbox-policy.mode: danger-full-access`、 `approval.policy: ask`、`permission.defaultPreset: danger-full-access`、 `system-prompt.includeHarnessIdentity: false`。 > desktop profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，无法用 CLI 直接 dump；但加载器相同， > 且本插件不依赖版本号敏感的内部源码，仅用 `systemPrompt` / `approval` / `cordis` > 标准接口，因此 rc.2 / rc.3 及以上均适用（无源码补丁可被打断）。 --- ## 版本自适应（v1.1） 宿主升级后（如 0.2.1-rc.3 → rc.5）不需要改插件源码。`lib/harness.js` 在运行时直接读 **正在运行的这套 DSH** 的安装内容，反推契约，不依赖版本号字符串： | 探测项 | 来源 | rc.3 → rc.5 的实际变化 | |---|---|---| | harness 版本 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base/package.json` | — | | bundle patch 集合 | profile `dsh.profile.bundles` → 各包 `dsh.bundle.patch`（string **或 string[]**） | `dsh-web-app` 现在是数组，带 `presets/*.patch.yml` | | entry id | bundle patch 的 `- id:` 条目（rc.5 实测 244 条） | **未变**：`approval` / `permission` / `tool-result-pruner` 仍是这三个 id | | 包名 | 同上 `name:` | **变了**：`dsh-approval`→`dsh-user-approval`，`dsh-permission`→`dsh-permission-presets`，`dsh-tool-result-pruner`→`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` | | service 名 | 包源码 `super(ctx, "")` | 未变（`systemPrompt` / `approval`） | | 审批事件 | 包源码里的 `"*/request"` 字面量 | 未变（`approval/request`） | | order 常量 | `dsh-system-prompt` 的 `SECTION_ORDERS` | 未变（`HARNESS_IDENTITY: -1e3`、`APPROVAL_POLICY: 115`） | 三条兜底：自省命中 → 候选别名表 → 内置默认值。任一层失败都不会让插件不加载。 ### 另一个跨版本隐患：静态 inject 旧版 profile 里的本体行写死了： ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-po name: dsh-po inject: [ systemPrompt, tools ] # ← 宿主服务改名/拆分时整插件不加载 ``` v1.1 起不再写这一行，依赖由 `lib/index.js` 在运行时解析（`ctx.get()` → `ctx.inject()` → 轮询兜底）。已安装的 profile 用 `dsh-po adapt` 一行清除。 ### 升级宿主后的标准动作 ```sh cd ~/Documents/DSHunlimited/dsh-po node bin/dsh-po.js status # 看 entry id / service / 事件 / order 是否全部 OK node bin/dsh-po.js verify # CI 用：未解析目标则退出码 1 node bin/dsh-po.js adapt # id 真被改名时重写本体 patch；顺手清静态 inject npm test # 含真实宿主自省用例 ``` 改完**完全退出并重启** dsh 宿主（web / desktop）才生效。 ### 已实测 - `0.2.1-rc.5`（cordis 4.0.5，app.asar 18 MB，244 条 entry）：8 个逻辑目标全部 `OK` - rc.3 旧包名 / 未来改 id 两种形态由 `test/adapt.test.mjs` 覆盖

Exact npm 1.1.4 gitHead matches, but neither repository nor package licensing is established. dsh.compat lists claimed verification on DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 through rc.5; no runtime verification was performed here. The patch selects danger-full-access and the native runtime defaults approvalResult to allowed-once, changing the approval boundary. postinstall runs ensure-profile-bundle.mjs and can mutate profile membership. These policy changes require explicit acceptance; no hook was run. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-vscode-mode

> DSH 上的**类 VSCode 编码体验**：Monaco 文件编辑器 + Agent 差异审查 + LSP 智能。
> 由 `@dsh-external/dsh-edit-review` 重构而来。

- 📝 **同屏编辑**：DSH 0.1.5+ 官方右侧 Sidebar，AI 对话与文件编辑同屏
- 🔍 **差异审查**：Keep / Undo / 回滚 / 归档，状态持久化重启不丢
- 🧠 **LSP 智能**：转到定义 / 查找引用 / Peek 多结果选择 / 智能补全（注释索引）/ 签名帮助
- ⌨️ **命令面板**：`Ctrl+Shift+P`，19 条命令开箱即用，可编程扩展

## 目录

- [特性](#特性)
- [安装](#安装)
- [使用指南](#使用指南)
- [配置](#配置)
- [截图](#截图)
- [开发](#开发)
- [常见问题](#常见问题)
- [更新日志](#更新日志)

## 特性

### 1. 侧边栏文件编辑（推荐形态）

检测到 DSH 0.1.5+ 官方右侧 Sidebar（`ctx.sidebarRightTabs` / `ctx.sidebarRight`）时，
编辑器注册为官方侧边栏 Tab，AI 对话（中央）与文件编辑（右侧）同屏，支持官方
多标签 / 分栏 / 浮出 / 全屏，打开路由即开即展开，官方引导页提供入口。

- **形态优先级**：官方 Sidebar > [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)
  （桥已归档，仅作旧版回退）> 中央文件编辑页签（零新依赖完整可用）；
  编辑器顶部与设置页「兼容性」子 Tab 给出对应引导。
- **文件链接（DSH 0.1.5+）**：聊天 / 文件树链接经官方 `ctx.sidebarRight.openResource`
  直达右侧栏；「文件链接使用工具」为 自动 / VSCodeMode 时以 extension 档认领
  `dsh-resource://file/**`（Monaco 打开，含行号定位），为「官方侧边栏」档时走
  官方文本查看器；畸形地址自动回落官方查看器。
- **文件页签**：脏点 / 关闭 / 「+」打开 / 右键菜单 / 固定（📌 排最前、隐藏 ×、
  随工作区持久化；**固定 = 保护**，批量关闭永不误关固定页签）。
- **页签数量上限**（通用设置 `maxOpenEditors`，默认 10，**0 = 不限制**）：超限时自动
  关闭**最久未使用**的页签；固定页签与当前活动页签受保护，脏页签在关闭前静默落盘。
- **页签栏滚轮横滚**：页签栏溢出（出现水平滚动条）时，鼠标滚轮（含触控板纵向手势）
  直接横向滚动页签栏；不溢出时不接管，`Shift+滚轮` 沿用浏览器原生横滚。
- **页签右键菜单**（对齐 VS Code）：添加到对话 / 关闭·关闭其他·关闭右侧·关闭已
  保存·全部关闭（`Ctrl+F4` 关当前）/ 复制路径·复制相对路径 / 在文件资源管理器
  （视图）中显示。关闭前未保存页签静默落盘；浏览器无法实现的条目（向右拆分 /
  新窗口）不提供。
- **工作区搜索填充**：编辑器有选中时执行「工作区搜索」（当前键位见官方快捷键目录），
  选中文本自动填入搜索框并立即搜索（多行选区取首行；填入后全选，便于直接改写）。
- **Markdown 预览**（v0.5.3）：打开 `.md` / `.markdown` 后，工具栏「预览」按钮、
  `Ctrl+Shift+V` 或命令栏「切换 Markdown 预览」切入 GFM 渲染（标题/列表/表格/代码块/
  引用/KaTeX），「以源码打开」切回编辑。渲染走官方 `MarkdownText` 原语，零新增依赖、
  自动跟随 DSH 主题；旧版 DSH 缺该原语时降级为纯文本预览。活动文件不是 Markdown 时
  不吞 `Ctrl+Shift+V`（保留「粘贴为纯文本」）。
- **DSH 计划模式接入**：工作区 `plans/`、DSH `.dsh/plans/` 下的 Markdown 计划文件，
  以及成功生成且以 `# 计划：` / `# 计划:` 标题显式关联的 Markdown，默认以预览打开；
  指定行号的链接仍进入源码定位，普通 Markdown 的既有打开方式不变。
  当前会话成功写入/修改计划文件、提交完整计划后自动打开预览；刷新、历史翻页、重连和
  切换会话不会重播旧计划。官方「打开计划」及待审批计划同样转入文件编辑器的只读计划
  页签（最多保留 32 份，退出编辑器后不持久化虚拟正文），不写磁盘、不接入 LSP/SVN/保存；
  审批仍使用对话中的官方控件。打开失败可点击「在官方计划查看器打开」，不影响原审批。
  缺少官方 Sidebar/计划服务的旧版 DSH 保留原查看器；自动生成检测需要 Session 事件源。
- **Monaco Editor**：语法高亮 / 行号 / `Ctrl+F` / `Ctrl+G` / `Ctrl+S` /
  700ms 防抖自动保存；顶部工具栏显示 路径 / 语言 / Ln,Col / 保存状态，提供
  差异 / 侧边栏 / 刷新入口。

### 6. 差异审查（核心能力）

Host 优先采集官方 `workspaceChanges` 的轮次净差异；旧版逐工具记录保留兼容，
同一路径有官方记录时不重复计数。客户端复用现有差异列表、角标和编辑器操作条，
不增加独立审查栏。

- 编辑器未打开 → 差异角标和总览；打开文件后 → 文件内增删区域、↑↓ 定位与
  Keep / Undo。无法唯一映射到当前内容的历史块仍可查看，但不会标在猜测的位置。
- 官方原始摘要及 hunks、审查决定分别保存到插件工作区 SQLite 数据库；跨轮次
  pending 保留。手动保存、文件失配和列表容量限制均不表示已审；旧旁车仅供迁移。
- **Keep** 只改变审查状态，不写文件；支持整条记录或单块处理，尚有 pending 块时
  文件仍在待审列表。文件级动作不暗中处理同路径的其他轮次。
- **Undo** 需要与官方差异一致的独立原始字节证据。写回校验当前内容、文件版本及
  操作日志，保留 BOM、行尾和末尾换行；脏缓冲、版本竞争或内容冲突时拒绝覆盖，
  不把失败当作成功已审。没有受控删除能力的新建文件等场景不强行启用。
- 历史记录不会从当前文件倒推虚构基线；缺证据时仍可看差异和 Keep，但 Undo 禁用
  并说明原因。新证据采集限本会话可观测的 `edit` / `write`，不承诺覆盖 shell、
  外部编辑器或旧 Host 启动前的修改。升级 Host 后需要重启才能启用新回调。

> v0.20.1 已完成重启后真实 GUI 的文件/块级审查与安全拒绝验收。Keep All / Undo All
> 已接入全部分页；批量 Undo 不是跨文件原子事务，遇冲突停止，已完成项不会自动恢复。

### 6.1 累计基线待审（对齐 dsh-diff-approval）

在保留现有面板的前提下，把待审内核换成**累计基线投影**：行为参考
[dsh-diff-approval](https://github.com/9087/dsh-diff-approval)（基线
`a661a7a31583057c8ba8bbeb73721a9b3ee0c57e`，MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Wu Zhiwei），
只借用语义与内核，不引入它的界面资产（Markdown 预览、并排视图、字体子集、悬浮卡片）。

- **一条目一文件**：每路径只有一条待审条目，`oldText` 是最早基线、`newText` 是最新内容。
  同文件多次写入按更新时间折叠，基线取较早来源、内容取较晚来源，`sessionIds` 取并集；
  于是 A→B→C 显示 A→C，A→B→A 折叠归零（严格字节相等，不做 BOM/换行归一化）。
- **创建身份**：`earlierVersion: 'none'` 表示基线是"文件不存在"。写入推进基线即结束创建
  身份（转为 `'file'`），此后再 Revert 是写回而不是删除。
- **判定粒度**：块、行区间、文件、全部。**Keep 只推进投影、零写盘**；Revert 才写回文件，
  新建条目整条 Revert 等于删除该文件。块身份由当前差异现场推导，不依赖落库状态。
- **判定安全**：Revert 走 `replaceIfVersion` 版本守卫并写后读回；内容与投影不一致、
  条目已解决、行区间歧义时拒绝并给出原因码（`revision-mismatch` / `diverged` /
  `settled` / `unknown-block` / `no-block` / `ambiguous-block`）。
- **撤销/重做**：判定入 `pending_history`（游标模型，撤销后重做回到同一状态），
  幂等由 `operationId` 保证；决策栈跨重启保留（上游只在面板打开期间保留）。
- **差异来源**：`edit` / `write` 结果自带 before/after 直接采集；`str_replace_editor`
  结果只有成功消息，靠 `fs/edit-intent`、`fs/write-intent` 在写前取预像、`fs/observed`
  在写后取终像配对。可另外从版本库导入基线改动（git / svn / Perforce）。
- **外部改动**：已入列路径被外部改写时，新内容被吸收为最新待审内容并标记分歧，
  基线保持不动；文件缺失/读不到时条目转为 `missing`，不再参与写回。
- **判定入口**：差异直接画在编辑器里，块级 Keep/Undo 用行内药丸；文件级 Keep/Undo
  在差异栏上。详情面板与批注（含「让 AI 应答」）已移除——判定与保持/撤销只走这两处。

与上游的有意偏差：

| 项 | 上游 | 本插件 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 条目键 | 全局裸路径 | 工作区 + 路径 | 多工作区同名文件不能互相覆盖 |
| 文本存储 | 内存/全量 JSON | SQLite，有大小上限 | 大文件不拖垮 Host，超大只按时间戳比较 |
| Revert 写回 | 无条件写 | 版本守卫 + 写后读回 | provider 不具备跨进程原子 CAS |
| 撤销栈 | 仅面板打开期间 | 持久化到 SQLite | 重启后仍可撤销上次决定 |
| 界面 | 自带整套 UI | 复用现有面板 | 保留本插件视觉与交互 |
| Perforce | 支持 | 支持，但只有假 shell 单测 | 本机无 p4 客户端，无法真机验证 |
| 新建文件 Revert | 删除文件 | 删除文件（直接 `unlink`） | fs 抽象没有删除动作，已限制在工作区内 |

数据与迁移：新增 `pending_*` 表，`SCHEMA_VERSION` 递增并用 `PRAGMA table_info` 判缺列后
`ALTER TABLE`，既有 `review_*` 事实表一概不动；首次改动前写 `.before-pending.bak` 备份；
路径被待审投影接管后，旧 sidecar 写入口（`edrv.accept` / `edrv.reject` / `edrv.decideBatch`
/ `edrv.missingDecide` 等）直接拒绝，避免双权威。

- **项目作用域**（v0.13.0）：工具、资源与服务器指令均按 agent 所属工作区隔离；
  跨工作区子会话不会因继承父 scope 而获得外项目 MCP。全局 MCP 保持全局可用。
- **实例与状态**：每个活动 agent、每个启用项目服务各有一个插件实例；没有活动
  agent 时只保存配置（`configured`、实例数 0）。`instanceCount` 是挂载实例数，
  `unverified` 表示没有公开连接状态证据，不能把 fiber ACTIVE 当成已连接。
  零工具可能是合法的纯资源服务器。
- **配置保护**：reconcile 尊重 `disabled`；读取/解析错误保留最后有效连接，
  不把不可读文件当成空配置。保存保留未知字段和未改动的脱敏凭据。

完整配置、迁移与排错见随包 [MCP 技能](skills/dsh-vscodemode-mcp/SKILL.md)。

### 12. 插件自带技能组（v0.3.3）

一组 `SKILL.md` 随包分发并注册进 DSH 技能系统（自定义 skill provider，
`ctx.skills.registerProvider`）——**装了本插件即可用**，无需手工放到
`~/.dsh/skills`。当前收录 **`dsh-vscodemode-mcp`**（MCP 配置与使用指南：
两种作用域 / `.mcp.json` 写法 / `mcp.*` RPC / 命名与冲突 / 工作区隔离 /
故障排查表）。装载状态见 设置 → VSCodeMode →「兼容性」→「插件技能组」；
编辑 SKILL.md 即时生效（fs.watch → invalidate）。

- **命名硬约束**：技能名必须 kebab-case（`/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`），
  下划线非法（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` 直接拒绝）；本插件另加前缀白名单
  （不以 `dsh-vscodemode-` 开头跳过并告警，避免污染全局技能命名空间）。
- **frontmatter**：`name`（必填，kebab-case + 前缀）/ `description`（必填，
  模型靠它判断何时加载）/ `whenToUse`（可选）/ `disable-model-invocation`
  （true = 不进模型目录，仅人工显式调用）/ `user-invocable`（false = 禁止
  人工显式调用）；不接受遗留写法 `disableModelInvocation` / `modelInvocable` /
  `userInvocable`。
- **装载与降级**：`ctx.inject(['skills'])` 惰性获取（不写进 `inject` 数组），
  skills 服务缺失时插件其余功能不受影响；服务缺失 / 无 `registerProvider` /
  名冲突 → warn 跳过，不抛错、不影响装配；监听不可用时降级「改动需重载插件」。
- **为什么自研 provider**：开发形态（junction 安装）下官方
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` 按 realpath 解析 import 会
  `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`（walk 不到 profile 的 node_modules），且每实例会
  多拉 chokidar watcher；自研零新依赖、开发 / 正式形态行为一致、可单测。

### 13. 会话性能管理（设置 → VSCodeMode →「性能优化」）

DSH 启动回放 `~/.dsh/sessions` 全部会话（V8 展开约 10×，可能 OOM）。该子页
提供四项治理手段：

- **盘点**：全工作区会话体积 / 活跃度 / 新旧一览（`edrv.perf.inventory`）。
- **移出归档（可逆）**：巨型 / 旧会话移到 `~/.dsh/sessions-archive`
  （同卷 rename + `.manifest.json`），免重启即从下次启动回放剔除；支持恢复 /
  清除（`movePlan / moveOut / restore / purgeArchive`）。活跃会话一律拒绝移出。
- **压缩调优**：一键把更低 `compaction-basic`（0.6 / 0.12）与 `tool-result-pruner`
  （4096）阈值写入 profile `cordis.patch.yml`（标记块 + 备份 `.bak-<ts>`，可撤销，
  重启生效）；⚠️ 压缩只追加事件、**不重写**已持久化日志——**存量瘦身靠
  「移出到归档」**。
- **会话体积指示器**：对话 header `edrv-perf-size` ≥1MB 显示、≥2MB 琥珀、
  ≥8MB 红，引导「一次任务一个短会话」。
- 治理原则：存量靠归档、增量靠压缩调优 + 短会话习惯 + 体积指示器；packChunks
  （chunk 打包存储）为 DSH 默认开启，无需再配置。

### 14. 外部改动自动同步（即将发布）

磁盘文件被外部改动（其他编辑器 / Unity / 脚本 / agent 工具 / 同步盘）后自动
跟进，不必手点 ⟳：

- **观测**：客户端每 1.5s 把已打开页签路径批量交给 host `edrv.versions`
  （一次请求多条 `fs.stat`，标签页隐藏时整轮跳过），与本地版本基线比对；
  文件树对应目录同步失效，客户端按 `edrv:file-changed` 事件去抖强制重列。
- **判定**：版本变化后**必须再比一次内容**（版本令牌含 `ctime`，格式化工具 /
  同步盘的「同字节重写」也会让它变化）；内容一致 → 只推进基线（不重载）；
  内容不同且缓冲**干净** → 自动刷入并提示「已同步外部修改」；内容不同且有
  未保存编辑 → **绝不覆盖**，编辑区提示条三选一（重新加载 / 覆盖磁盘 /
  保留本地）+ 状态栏「⚠ 外部已修改」；文件被删 → 提示「已被外部删除」，
  缓冲保留。
- **保存护栏**：保存带回上次读取的版本令牌，host 用 `replaceIfVersion` 守卫
  写入——磁盘被外部改过时**拒绝保存**并提示「文件已被外部修改」，由用户显式
  选择重新加载或用编辑器内容覆盖；冲突未处理期间自动保存被抑制。
- 老 host（无该 RPC）自动降级为无同步、无护栏，不报错。

### 15. 系统集成（v0.1.53；v0.13.0 更新打开链路）

设置 → VSCodeMode → 通用 →「系统集成」卡片提供文件管理器右键菜单与 Unity
外部脚本编辑器。两者现在共用按 profile 隔离的本机私有 OPEN 请求/ACK 通道，
无需向 launcher 或 Unity 提供 Host Cookie，也不依赖固定 HTTP 端口。

**① 文件管理器右键菜单**

- Windows 提供文件、目录、目录空白处三类入口；Linux 提供 Nautilus 脚本与
  Dolphin 服务菜单；macOS 提供 Finder Automator 快速操作配方。
- **注册和移除必须由用户在设置页显式操作**。插件 reload/更新只升级已注册的
  launcher 文件及配置，保留所选 profile；不会自动重注册或撤销系统菜单。
  卸载插件前如需清理菜单，请先点「移除注册」。
- Windows 优先使用编译后的 C# launcher，缺少编译器时回退 PowerShell；
  POSIX 使用 Bash launcher。三个入口统一调用随包 `dsh-open.mjs` producer，
  从配置读取所选 profile、私有收件箱和运行程序。
- 已打开的客户端可以领取请求并就地打开。需要唤起时，Desktop 使用官方
  `dsh://open` 入口，Web 使用用户选定的完整应用地址（含实际端口和部署子路径）。
  **唤起窗口或领取请求本身不代表打开成功**。

**打开与回执规则**

| 阶段 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 投递 | producer 将带请求 id、目标 profile、路径和可选行列的 OPEN 请求写入当前用户私有队列 |
| 领取 | 客户端领取带 lease 的请求，按工作区/会话路由到文件编辑器 |
| 确认 | 只有目标路径对应的实际 Monaco model 或预览内容成功就绪，才提交匹配请求与 lease 的成功 ACK |
| 失败/超时 | 返回失败或未确认；不会把一个已展开的空页签视为成功 |

请求按 profile 与请求身份匹配，队列内容受类型、大小、时效和本机权限检查约束；
producer 只承担「打开」请求，不是通用 RPC 代理。旧 `edrvOpen/edrvPaths` URL
参数仍作为兼容入口保留，已不是 launcher 和 Unity 的当前主链。

文件与目录仍按现有工作区路由：工作区内文件进入相应会话；无会话时可创建会话；
目录根据是否位于已注册工作区内选择复用或新建。选择取消会结束该请求。行列定位
与真正加载的目标文件绑定，避免切换文件时把其他 model 的内容当成完成证据。

**② Unity 外部脚本编辑器（内嵌包 `com.dsh.editor` 0.3.1）**

1. 在设置卡片中选择 Unity 项目，执行安装/更新，将随包 UPM 目录复制到
   `<项目>/Packages/com.dsh.editor`；无需修改项目 manifest。
2. 首次安装会自动准备当前 profile 的独立 bridge，并写入本机项目提示
   `<项目>/UserSettings/dsh-editor.ini`；**无需先注册系统右键菜单**。
3. 在 Unity Preferences → External Tools 选择「DSH 文件编辑」。双击文本脚本、
   Console 报错行列或使用打开项目入口，会通过统一 producer 等待 ACK。
4. Unity 的「DSH 桥接配置」可填写绝对路径覆盖自动选择。优先级为：UI 显式覆盖 →
   项目 UserSettings 提示 → 提示缺失时的旧 shell 配置回退；损坏提示会报错，
   不会静默切换到另一个 profile。

UserSettings 提示包含本机 profile 路径，不适合作为团队共享配置。换机器或切换
profile 后应重新安装/更新桥接，或在 Unity UI 中显式指定对应 bridge 配置。

Unity 包保留文本/代码扩展名白名单与用户自定义扩展；Prefab、场景等资产仍交还
Unity 原生处理，不生成 csproj。Unity API 与 EditorPrefs 在主线程使用；后台任务
负责 producer 与 IO。安装目标已有同名目录但不是本包时拒绝覆盖，卸载仅删除该包目录。

- 管理 RPC：`edrv.integration.status/register/unregister`、`edrv.unity.list/add/remove/install`。
- 保存文件仍遵循当前会话沙箱策略；外部打开成功不扩大文件写入权限。
- 当前验证边界：Windows 官方 Desktop 已完成隔离启动与侧栏挂载等检查；Unity
  仅有 C# 编译桩与 9 项 hint 探针，尚未执行真实 Unity EditMode。Linux/macOS
  尚无本轮现场验证。具体完成项与待验收项见 [0.13 发布说明](docs/release-0.13.0.md)。

  `运行到行` = 临时断点 + 继续（命中/手动继续后自动清理，不污染用户断点表）；
  `添加触发的断点...` 当前适配器不支持 → 点击给出明确提示（不做静默失败的假功能）。

### 18. 界面状态记忆（v0.14.0，跨重启）

DSH 每次启动监听随机端口，`http://127.0.0.1:<port>` 就是浏览器 origin，**只写
`localStorage` 的界面状态换一次启动就全丢**。本版把界面状态镜像到 DSH home，重启后
自动恢复。

- **记忆项**：打开的页签与活动页签（含固定态）、每个文件的光标与滚动位置（Monaco
  `saveViewState()`）、侧栏开关/宽度/面板、资源管理器展开与工作区折叠、官方编辑 Tab
  激活态、Markdown 预览态（按文件）、导航历史（前进/后退）、规则分页、搜索面板、
  SVN 过滤与折叠、调试面板监视与折叠、DAP 四段分栏高度、断点（按适配器语言）。
- **存储位置**：`DSH_HOME/dsh-vscode-mode/cache/workspace/<hashOf(cwd)>/ui.v1.json`
  （工作区私有）与 `cache/user/ui-globals.v1.json`（跨工作区共享，如工作区折叠）。
  写前合并，同一文件内多工作区/多键互不覆盖；单键超 64 KB 分片上传。
- **不镜像**：目录条目缓存（`edrv.cache.entries.v2.*`，体积大且可重建）；临时弹窗、
  未落盘的编辑缓冲不恢复。
- **恢复语义**：启动时取回镜像回填 `localStorage`，**本地已有值一律保留**（不覆盖
  当前 origin 的真实状态）；回填完成后广播 `edrv:ui-state-ready`，晚到的界面组件据此
  重跑恢复。取回失败按 8×800ms 有界重试，重试耗尽则退回纯 `localStorage`（行为与
  0.14.0 之前一致），不阻断插件加载、不拖慢启动（slot 注册前最多等 600ms）。
- **自检**：设置页「兼容性」与 RPC `edrv.compat` 可查看运行时报告；镜像读写的时间线记在
  `DSH_HOME/dsh-vscode-mode/logs/debug.<hashOf(cwd)>.log`（无会话期诊断落在
  `debug.<hashOf('ui-state')>.log`）。

```

> **DSH 版本政策（0.17.0 起）**：六项 DSH peer 仍统一声明为 `*`，另以
> `engines.dsh: ">=0.1.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0"` 显式声明支持的 DSH 运行时区间——
> `engines.dsh` 一旦声明就**单独决定**兼容性（官方实现：`An own engines.dsh range
> decides alone and peerDependencies are ignored`），不满足时安装会被直接拒绝。
> 该区间接受 0.1.0-rc.1 起的全部 0.1.x / 0.2.x，拒绝 0.3.0 及以后的主版本；
> DSH 自身以 `includePrerelease` 求值，故 alpha、rc 与正式版同等对待。
> 运行时仍按实际能力检查；允许安装不代表该版本已通过全功能验收。
> 已发布包仍以其实际声明为准；npm 安装前应确认注册表中版本可查询。
> 替换已有包后需重启目标 DSH Host 并强制刷新原页面；仅刷新不会更新 Host。
> 从 0.14.2 或更旧版本升级时，首次访问工作区会执行 0.14.3 引入的 SQLite 活跃记录迁移。
>
> `dsh plugin ...` 是 pnpm 转发器：git 安装会克隆仓库、执行该包 `prepare` 脚本
> （tsdown 双面构建）后安装，再按 `dsh.bundle` 声明自动加入 profile 的 bundles
> 层。若 pnpm 提示构建脚本需批准，把 key 加到
> `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds` 后重跑。

**安装即生效，无需任何手动配置**：本包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 是标准 bundle
自挂载补丁（`- insert: { id: dsh-vscode-mode, name: dsh-vscode-mode }`），加入
bundles 层后重启 DSH 即自动把插件行挂进 loader 树。**不要**再往 profile 用户层
`cordis.patch.yml` 手写 `insert`（旧的非标准做法，会与本 bundle 行撞同一 id，
触发 duplicate loader entry id 启动失败）。

自定义配置（如图标目录 `imageDir`）用 **id 定向覆盖**合并到 bundle 行上，
而不是再 insert 一次：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml（用户层，应用顺序在 bundle 层之后）
- id: dsh-vscode-mode
  config:
    imageDir: C:/Users/me/Pictures   # 可选，默认读插件包内 assets/
```

> 迁移提示：若你之前按旧版指引在 profile 用户层手写过 `insert`（id 恰为
> `dsh-vscode-mode`），升级后请把那一段 `insert` 改成上面的 id 定向覆盖
> （或直接删除），避免与本 bundle 行重复装配。

- 更新：`dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-vscode-mode`
- 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-vscode-mode`

## 使用指南

### 打开文件

- **文件树**：资源管理器面板点击打开；**文件链接**（DSH 0.1.5+）：聊天 / 文件树
  里的文件链接直达右侧栏编辑器（含行号定位）。
- **快速打开**：执行插件 QuickOpen 命令（键位见「设置 → 快捷键」）——`↑↓` 选择、
  `Enter` 打开高亮项、`Esc` 关闭，鼠标悬停与高亮同步；`Ctrl+P` 由官方文件切换使用。
- **差异入口**：对话输入框上方 dock 的「差异 N 个文件 · 查看下一个」按钮。

### 快捷键速查

以下是桌面端常见默认键位；Web / Linux 的浏览器或系统保留键可能不绑定。
实际生效键位以 **DSH 官方快捷键配置**为准：设置 → VSCodeMode → 通用 →「打开官方
快捷键配置」（或 `Ctrl+/`）。插件命令与官方命令同表展示、由官方统一校验冲突；
旧版 DSH 无官方 shortcuts 时沿用原有键位。

| `Ctrl+Shift+P` / `F1` | 命令面板 |
| `Ctrl+U` | 选中内容加为引用（Add Selection to Chat） |

### 差异审查流程

1. agent 执行 `edit` / `write` 后，对话输入框上方出现差异 dock。
2. 点击「差异 N 个文件 · 查看下一个」打开侧栏编辑器并聚焦差异；编辑器打开后
   dock 变为完整操作条：**Keep**（采纳）/ **Undo**（拒绝）/ 跳转 / 回滚 /
   归档对比。
3. 每条差异处理完成立即归档；DiffLauncher 全局总览支持按批次浏览 + 回滚；
   状态持久化到 `.dsh-edit-review.json`，重启不丢。

### 引用、片段与 LSP

- **快捷引用**：选中内容 `Ctrl+U`（或页签右键 / 文件树右键），插入点跟随输入框
  光标，送入对话上下文。
- **代码片段**：`Ctrl+Shift+P` →「配置代码片段」编辑 `.code-snippets`；编辑代码
  时 `prefix` 自动 IntelliSense 补全，`Tab` / `Enter` 展开。
- **LSP**：`F12` 转到定义（多结果弹 Peek 选择）、`Shift+F12` 查找引用、
  `Ctrl+点击` 导航；取不到定义自动降级「转到引用」。补全随输入 `.` / `:` / `(` / `[`
  自动弹出（`Ctrl+Space` 手动触发，`Tab` / `Enter` 采纳），函数实参处显示签名帮助。

## 开发

### 构建（自足，无需 DSH 源码 checkout）

```bash
pnpm install          # 安装 devDeps（typescript/tsdown/@types/node/@types/react/react/vitest）
pnpm build            # tsdown 双面：lib/index.js（host esm）+ lib/client.js（client cjs）
pnpm typecheck        # tsc --noEmit
pnpm test             # vitest 纯函数用例
npm pack              # 产物 tgz（含 lib/assets/src/cordis.patch.yml）
```

`scripts/build.sh` 被 `dev_build_plugin` 等注入工具调用（本地标准构建）。
`prepare` 脚本 = 构建，git 安装 / npm publish 都会自动执行。

### 开发形态（devForm）

开发形态 = 当前运行 profile 以 `link:` 依赖和链接入口指向源码目录。设置 → 通用
可查看和切换形态；切换成功后需要重启 DSH 才能加载新的 Host 代码。

- **定位当前 profile**：优先使用官方 `profileContext.dir`；旧宿主仅在依赖本插件的
  profile 候选唯一时回退。服务信息无效或候选有歧义时拒绝切换，不猜测 `web` 目录。
- **失败恢复**：写入前备份 manifest、lockfile 和原安装入口；安装失败时恢复原内容
  与链接身份。若恢复本身失败，会保留备份位置供处理，不能宣称已经恢复成功。
- **开发目录校验**：要求绝对路径、正确包身份，且不位于被替换的 profile
  `node_modules` 内；移除链接只处理链接本身，不递归删除源码。
- **运行程序**：有官方 `profileContext.packageManager` 时使用它提供的程序、参数和
  显式环境（含 Desktop 自带运行方式）；旧宿主再回退 PATH。

程序化调用继续使用插件已有 RPC，但须经当前已鉴权应用的同源通道；未携带有效
Host 身份的裸 HTTP/curl 请求不再是支持的接入方式。请求地址应保留应用子路径，
Desktop 应沿用当前 `dsh-app:` 应用上下文，不拼接固定 `localhost` 端口。

| 方法 | `args` | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| `vscode.devFormGet` | `{}` | 读取当前形态，兼容性报告也包含 `devForm` |
| `vscode.devFormSet` | `{ "enabled": true, "path": "<源码绝对路径>" }` | 开启开发形态；按返回的 `restart` 重启 |
| `vscode.devFormSet` | `{ "enabled": false }` | 切回当前插件版本的正式依赖；按返回的 `restart` 重启 |

### 源码结构

```
src/
├── index.ts          Host 入口：name/inject/apply（薄装配，含兼容性报告启动日志）
├── shared/           ★ 双面契约（禁 node/react）：types/rpc/compat/mcp
├── compat.ts         ★ Host 兼容层：外部插件探测、路由/重复装配护栏、兼容性报告
├── devForm.ts        Host 开发形态管理：link:/junction 切换（RPC vscode.devForm*）
├── model.ts          Host 纯域逻辑（可单测）：normalize/markDecision/summary/批次/归档
├── store.ts          Host 存储层：sidecar 读写合并 + 归档持久化 + stale 检测
├── workspace.ts      Host 工作区文件扫描（TTL 缓存）+ 快速打开搜索
├── revert.ts         Host 回滚/删除（fs + subprocess，fs.contains 边界校验）
├── registry.ts       Ho

# dsh-context-rescue

![test](https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)

**Emergency rescue for DeepSeek Harness sessions that hit the model context window.**

Your session answers every message with `400` because one request is larger than the
provider will accept. `/compact` does not help: it resends the same oversized surface, and
when a proxy owns compression it is refused outright. This plugin is the ambulance — it
detects the overflow, folds the oldest history into a durable digest, and retries the exact
same step, so the session continues instead of dying.

```
400 the request exceeds the model's context window
  └─ context-rescue: overflow detected (gw-prose, score 0.95)
     ├─ T1 prune tool output      → not available
     ├─ T2 host compaction        → refused by proxy, lane blocked for this process
     ├─ T3 mechanical fold        → 956 nodes → 169 nodes, 991,512 → 298,595 tokens
     └─ T4 oversized message      → only when history is one huge message: keep its head and tail
  └─ retry step → 200 OK
```

## Why this exists

The failure chain is well documented upstream (DSH discussion #10138) and it is a chain, not
a bug in one place:

1. the gateway rejects with prose the host classifier does not recognise, so the failure is
   never tagged `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`;
2. the host's context-overflow branch therefore never runs;
3. nothing shrinks the surface, so the retry is byte-identical and fails again — forever.

Every existing plugin in this space is **preventive** (roll the context window over, prune tool
output, compress through a proxy). None of them runs *after* the session is already wedged.
This one does nothing at all until a request fails, which is why it can be installed alongside
any of them.

## Install

```bash
# from this repository
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add git+https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue.git#master

# from a checkout
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-context-rescue

# from npm (0.2.2 is published)
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-context-rescue
```

The branch form follows `master`; the market entry instead pins a commit
(`git+…#<commit>`), so a listing points at a build that cannot move under it.

The plugin declares `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }` and inserts itself
as `context-rescue`. It imports **no** `@deepseek-ai/*` package at runtime — every host
structure it touches (`surfaceOp`, `compaction/*`, the pairing rule, the model-info resolver)
is constructed locally against the documented wire shape. A host upgrade cannot break the
plugin's imports, and it declares no host peer dependency to go missing.

Restart the session (or the app) after installing; a host reload is required for a new bundle.

## Marketplace listing

`market/` holds the icon and the generator for a **format-1 plugin market index entry**. The
entry is validated by the host's own `parseMarketIndex`, i.e. by the same code the Discover page
uses to read indexes:

```bash
# validate an entry whose Git source is this repository at a pinned commit
node scripts/make-market-index.mjs \
  --repo https://github.com/OWNER/dsh-context-rescue \
  --commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
  --out market/index.json

# or do the whole publish in one step: push, then pin the entry to the pushed commit
npm run publish:remote -- --repo OWNER/dsh-context-rescue --dry-run
```

It prints the resolved install spec (`git+https://…git#<commit>`, or `name@version` with
`--npm`) and exits non-zero on any violated rule, with the JSON path of the offending value.
`DSH_APP_ASAR` overrides where the validator is loaded from.

DSH only reads indexes a user configured: the market bundle is optional and ships with
`indexes: []`, so a listing is one discovery away.

This repository is already published, so a user has two routes:

```bash
# 1. straight from git — works without any marketplace, pin the commit you reviewed
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add git+https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue.git#<commit>
```

```text
# 2. through the Discover page
add the index source    https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue/raw/master/market/index.json
                        (Discover → index sources / "Add index source"; the official market bundle
                        @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market is optional and not present in every profile)
pick the entry          dsh-context-rescue — it installs the commit the entry pins, not a branch
```

The repository also carries the `dsh-plugin` topic so topic-scanning lists pick it up, and the
entry has been submitted to two curated lists (`docs/PUBLISH.md` records the PRs).

## Two ways to count the same thing

`measure()` prices the surface nodes; the provider is asked to accept the
*request*, which is what `session.deriveMessages()` builds. Those are different
numbers, and a session can look fine by the first and still be refused by the
second. `/rescue-status` reports both, and the host gate asserts the second one:
after every fold, the derived request must be smaller than before **and** under
the window.

## When nothing can work

Some sessions cannot be rescued: the system prompt alone can already be over the
window. The plugin tries every tier once, then remembers the session as
defeated and stops measuring it -- otherwise every single request in that
session would pay a full measurement and fail the same way. The step still
runs, the request is still attempted, and the failure is passed through
unchanged. `/rescue` (or `context_rescue` with `action: "rescue"`) always tries
once more, and any rescue that does work reopens the normal path.

That verdict belongs to the window and the shape of the history it was reached under, not to the
session forever: switching to a model with more room, or a projection that has grown since, drops
it and the session is measured again, in both the failure path and the step check. Otherwise
changing models -- the obvious thing to try when a session is stuck -- would keep the plugin
looking away.

## What the checkpoint keeps

The digest is written without a model, so it keeps *facts*, not prose: errors and failures,
the task list, the operations that were run (one line each, repeats collapsed), the user's
requests, the most recent conclusions -- and the file paths the work touched. Paths are read
out of tool arguments whether the host stored them as a tree or, as it does in practice, as a
single JSON text blob; a fold that drops every path leaves the request small and the model lost.

## Before the request is sent

Waiting for the 400 costs a round trip, and some sessions never recover from one (discussion
#10138). So the same rescue also runs on `agent/pre-step`, one step earlier:

1. measure the projection the loop is about to send;
2. if it is already **larger than the model window**, the request cannot be accepted at all, so
   fold it there — T1 prune, then the zero-model checkpoint;
3. if it merely sits in the pressure band (`fitRatio × window` up to the window), do nothing:
   that is ordinary compaction policy and it belongs to the host.

The window comes from the model registry for the provider in the session header, then from the
session, then from `windowFallback`, and it is cached per target so a turn does not resolve it
once per step. T2 is deliberately skipped here: the host engine has its own pre-step hook, and
borrowing it would compact twice for one overshoot.

Measuring a large projection is the expensive part of a rescue — on this machine the full ladder
runs at a 1.1 s median, and almost all of it is pricing nodes. A pre-step hook runs on every step,
so it measures **once per turn** and afterwards only counts what was appended since: the second
check of a turn costs nothing measurable and still notices a large paste (any new message over
4,000 characters forces a real re-measurement, and so does a surface whose node count no longer
matches the cached one — someone else folded). `node scripts/dev/rescue-bench.mjs` prints the
distribution for the largest logs on this machine.

## What it does when a request fails
The listener runs on the `agent/request-error` waterfall, which fires for every failed request
regardless of the code the host assigned.

1. **Classify.** Score the failure against strong probes (gateway prose, `model's context
   window`, `no upstream can accept`, budget-vs-window arithmetic) and structured codes. Pull
   `requestTokens` / `windowTokens` out of the message when present — the window the failure
   *observed* beats the window the adapter *declared*.
2. **Measure.** Price the surface with the host token meter; fall back to a local estimate.
3. **Plan.** Compute balance-safe cuts with the host's own pairing rule (a tool call is an
   `assistant/message` content block, a result is a `tool/result`; mirror events do not move
   the balance). Keep the pinned head and the recent tail. Refuse to plan across an unclosed
   compaction transaction.
4. **Rescue, in tiers.**
   - **T1** — prune tool output through whatever pruner the host exposes (cheapest, no model).
   - **T2** — ask the host's compaction engine to do what it would have done: `compactIfNeeded(agent, 'context-overflow', signal)`.
     A borrowed engine only counts as a rescue when the projection actually shrank; an engine
     that resolves without doing anything falls through to T3. If a proxy refuses the lane
     (`dsh_compaction_refused`), remember that and never ask again in this process.
   - **T3** — write a checkpoint: `compaction/start` → `compaction/prune` → `user/message` with
     `surfaceOp: replace` → `compaction/end`, with a structured digest of the folded span.
   - **T4** — when the overshoot *is* one message (a file pasted into the newest turn), there is
     no span to fold around it: replace that message with its own head and tail, and state the
     original length and what was dropped. Only text messages whose removal keeps tool pairing
     balanced qualify; an orphan `tool/result` or an assistant message carrying calls is never
     touched on its own. When the oversize *is* a tool result, that result and the call answering
     it are replaced together — dropping either half alone would orphan the other.

   The system prompt is never excerpted: an excerpt of the instructions would keep the request
   legal while quietly removing what the turn was told to do, so if that is the only thing left
   over the window the ladder reports a failure instead of pretending. Several pasted blocks at
   once are handled in one pass — the fold takes the older span, and T4 cuts down what survives
   in the tail. Within what is left over, older history is excerpted first: the message typed
   into the current turn is what the turn is about, so it is only cut when nothing older is
   large enough to bring the request under the window.

5. **Retry once.** Return `{ kind: 'retry' }` so the loop resends the same step against the
   now-smaller surface. If every tier fails, or the per-turn budget is spent, delegate with
   `next()` and let the host report the real error.

The digest is structured, not a paraphrase: failures and errors, files and paths touched, task
list, key actions, user intent, recent conclusions. Long sessions lose detail, but they keep
their shape and their pointers.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `context_rescue` | `action: "status"` reports occupancy, capabilities and the last rescue; `action: "rescue"` runs the ladder now and folds without waiting for a failure |
| `context_rescue_estimate` | classify a pasted error text (optional `text`) and show the sizes it extracts, plus this session's occupancy |
| `context_rescue_fold` | fold the oldest history span right now — no parameters, the same mechanical fold `/rescue` runs — and report the token delta |

Tools never throw; they return a report object with `ok`, `reason` and counters.

## Commands

Two slash commands are registered whenever the host exposes a command registry (the same slot
`/compact` uses). They are optional — a profile without the registry still gets the automatic
path and the tools.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/rescue` | fold the oldest span now and report the token delta (`/rescue status` reports only) |
| `/rescue-status` | occupancy, resolved window, whether a fold is possible, what a fold would cost right now, and the last attempt |

The status line distinguishes the two things a rescue can do: it names the span a fold would
take, and when nothing can be folded it says which oversized message would be excerpted instead
of claiming there is nothing to do.

The registry may mount after this plugin; registration is retried when the service appears.
Results are one line of text, and a rescue folds through exactly the same code path as the
automatic one. Commands never throw.

## Configuration

All keys are optional; pass them through the plugin's config block.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | mount the plugin at all; `false` leaves the harness untouched |
| `mode` | `"auto"` | `auto` runs the full ladder (prune → host engine → mechanical fold → excerpt); `fold` runs the same ladder without the host compaction engine, so it never asks a model to summarise; `diagnose` detects and reports but rewrites nothing |
| `zeroModelOnly` | `false` | never call the model/compactor; go straight to the mechanical fold |
| `trimOversizedMessages` | `true` | when one message alone overflows, replace it with its own head and tail |
| `excerptChars` | `3000` | characters kept from each end when that happens |
| `allowModelCompaction` | `true` | allow T2 (the host engine) |
| `retainRatio` | `0.25` | share of the current surface kept as the recent tail |
| `retainMinTokens` / `retainMaxTokens` | `4000` / `40000` | clamps for the retained tail |
| `targetRatio` | `0.75` | fold until the surface is at most this share of the window |
| `fitRatio` | `0.9` | treat the surface as fitting below this share of the window |
| `minFoldTokens` | `4000` | below this, folding is not worth a transaction |
| `maxAttemptsPerTurn` | `2` | rescue budget per assistant turn |
| `maxDigestChars` | `12000` | hard cap on the checkpoint body |
| `pinFirstUserMessage` | `true` | keep the first user message outside every fold, unless that message alone is over the budget |
| `windowFallback` | `196608` | window used when neither the failure nor the model info provides one |
| `extraPatterns` | `[]` | regex sources added to overflow detection |
| `laneRefusalPatterns` | `["dsh_compaction_refused", "bili owns compression"]` | proxy refusals that permanently block T2 |
| `registerTools` | `true` | register the three tools |
| `registerCommands` | `true` | register `/rescue` and `/rescue-status` when the host has a command registry |
| `preflight` | `true` | fold on `agent/pre-step` when the projection is already over the window |
| `repairTransactions` | `true` | close a compaction bracket a crash left open; a dangling one blocks every later fold |
| `verbose` | `true` | log rescue decisions to the session |

### Configuration mistakes are reported, not swallowed

Options are validated when the plugin mounts. An unknown key (`retainRation`), a `mode` the
plugin does not know, a ratio outside its usable range, or a `targetRatio` that sits at or above
`fitRatio` is logged as a `config:` warning instead of quietly changing the behaviour you expect.
A rescue plugin that silently ignores a typo is indistinguishable from one that is not installed.

### The options are a real schema, not a wish list

`lib/schema.js` declares every option below as a Cordis/Schemastery schema, which the host uses in
two ways: it validates your patch **before** the plugin starts, and it documents the options in
`dsh --dump-config-schema`. A value the schema refuses (`retainRatio: 5`, `mode: aggressive`,
`preflight: "yes"`) stops the boot with the field name and the bound, instead of starting with a
silently clamped number:

```
$.retainRatio expected number <= 0.6 but got 5
```

Unknown keys are deliberately *left alone* by the schema so the warning above can name your typo —
the two checks cover different failures, and neither hides the other.

## Safety

- **Never corrupts the surface.** Fold boundaries are balance-safe by the host's own rule; a
  cut that would split a tool call from its result is not used. A fold that throws closes its
  transaction bracket with `compaction/end{error}` instead of leaving the session mid-write.
- **Never spends context for nothing.** If the measured projection already fits the window the
  failure reported, it retries unchanged instead of folding — the gateway can count more than
  the projection does, and a rewrite there would only cost history.
- **Never loops.** At most `maxAttemptsPerTurn` rescues per turn, then it steps aside.
- **Never deletes history.** A fold only appends: every original event stays in the session
  log, `eventAt(seq)` still resolves it, and only the projection stops containing it. Nothing a
  rescue hides is gone from the record, so a wrong fold costs you a projection, not the
  conversation — the log can still be read, replayed, or folded differently next time.
  `tests/fold.test.js` asserts it.
- **Never lies.** If nothing foldable exists (a single mega-message, or a pinned head larger
  than the window) it reports that and delegates, so you see the real error.
- **Never competes.** It does not register the `compaction` service, so a preventive compactor
  keeps its slot and gets first refusal at T2; with `zeroModelOnly` it never calls the lane at
  all. `npm run mount-check` proves the slot still routes to the host engine after the plugin
  mounts.

## Verification

```bash
node --test                          # unit + replay
npm run typecheck                    # JSDoc type contract over index.js and lib/
node scripts/simulate.js             # four failure scenarios against the real code
npm run scan                         # fold every oversized session log found on this machine
npm run host-session                 # the same folds through the host's own Session class
npm run coexist                      # rescue beside the host's real compaction engine
npm run e2e-install                  # install through the app's own CLI into a throwaway profile
npm run e2e-install -- --git         # same, but from the published git spec instead of a tarball
npm run market-install               # fetch the published market index, let the host parse it, install what it says
npm run boot-check                   # boot the real app: does apply() run, and does it survive a profile that owns the compression lane?
DSH_SESSION_LOG=<session.v4.jsonl.zstd> node --test tests/replay-real-log.test.js

# the same suite under the app's own Node, where the host validator is reachable
npm run test:host

# mount into the installed app's own cordis container and drive one rescue
npm run mount-check

# pack it, install it into a throwaway project, and let the host loader resolve the bundle
npm run install-smoke

# rehearse the whole publish flow against a throwaway clone and a local bare remote
# (also pins the branch rule: an empty remote gets main, an existing master keeps master)
npm run publish:rehearse

# build + validate a market index entry for this checkout
npm run market -- --repo-slug OWNER/dsh-context-rescue

# the optional npm release: checks the tree, the tarball list and the taken version,
# then stops at the one step that needs an account
npm run publish:npm -- --dry-run
```

The suite covers detection, pairing-safe planning, fold transactions, ladder behaviour, lane
refusal memory, per-turn budgets, a no-op borrowed engine, an already-fitting projection, a second
rejection that forces the ladder, an internal throw that is handed back to the host, and
measurement accuracy. `tests/replay-real-log.test.js`
additionally folds a log captured from a real session and re-checks the host invariants on the
result; it is skipped unless `DSH_SESSION_LOG` is set. `node scripts/dev/scan-sessions.mjs`
sweeps every log on this machine and folds each oversized one with zero model calls: 33 of 200
captured sessions exceed a 196,608-token window and all 33 are rescued, with no failure
(`docs/PLAN.md` §5). The counts here are a snapshot of this machine: they grow as
sessions are captured, and `scan` and `host-session` recompute them, so the numbers below are
that same snapshot rather than fixed constants.

`host-session` is the highest-fidelity gate and the reason the two bugs above were found. It loads
the `Session` class out of the installed app bundle and replays captured logs through it, so the
appends are validated by the host's `validateSessionEventData`, the projection is built by its
`SurfaceManager`, and the assertions are made on `deriveMessages()` — the exact message array the
next request would carry. 200 logs seed, 69 fold (twice each, to prove a folded session can be
folded again), 31 of those folds come from the pre-flight path before any request failed, and the
rest are skipped because the host itself cannot re-seed them in isolation (a foreign plugin's
message projection, or a pre-v4 log).

`boot-check` goes one level higher: it boots the application. It builds five throwaway profiles, four of
them from the shipped `headless` template — first a copy of this package whose `apply()` throws, and asserts
the host reports that error under the very entry it inserted (`context-rescue (dsh-context-rescue)`),
because a clean "no error" run would otherwise prove nothing; then the real tarball, and asserts the
boot walks past mounting with no error naming the plugin and stops at the model call, exactly where
a machine without an API key stops; finally `billion-context`, the proxy that owns the compression
lane on some machines, is installed next to the plugin and the composed profile is booted again, so
"works beside the lane owner" is measured instead of assumed; and `dsh-smart-compact`, the plugin
that overrides the compaction engine, gets the same treatment, because two plugins reaching for one
slot is a composition problem; the fifth profile is built from the `web` template instead, which is
the shape the desktop app composes, and the assertion there is that the entry lands in the same tree
as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-commands` — the bundle that renders the command surface a user sees.
That profile is then started for real: the host must print its URL, hand the printed URL's auth
cookie to a request, and serve the UI document. A bundle that breaks the GUI host never gets that far.
All five profiles are removed afterwards. It proves mounting, not inference.

`coexist` mounts the plugin beside the host's *real* compaction engine
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`, the one a stock profile puts in the slot) with a fake `llm`
that cannot summarize, and asserts three things: the plugin does not take the slot, a borrow that
returns without shrinking the projection is not recorded as a rescue, and both the engine and the
container are still intact after that borrow fails.

Borrowing is what makes the plugin safe to install next to a compactor that already owns the slot.
`dsh-smart-compact@0.5.3` subclasses the same engine and overrides
`compactIfNeeded(agent, trigger, signal)`: non-pressure triggers go straight through to the base
engine, a pending `new_context` request bypasses the pressure bands, and a refusal resolves `null`
rather than throwing. That override is why the plugin asks for `context-overflow` with the same
three arguments, treats `null` as "nothing shrank" and falls through to the zero-model fold, and a
unit test pins that an engine throwing for its own reasons (a budget measurement error, a base
engine failure) is neither counted as a lane refusal nor able to stop the fold.

`mount-check` is the integration gate: it loads the plugin into the **installed app's** cordis
4 container, so it exercises the real `inject`/`Service` wiring and the real
`ctx.waterfall('agent/request-error', payload, next)` dispatch instead of a hand-rolled context.
It asserts the tools land on the real `tools` service, the waterfall answers `{kind:'retry'}`,
the surface is rewritten with a checkpoint, the per-turn budget stops the third attempt, the
tools answer through the service, and — with a host compaction engine mounted first — the slot
still routes to that engine while the rescue still completes on the zero-model tier.

`install-smoke` is the packaging gate: `npm pack` decides what ships (the `files` list),
the tarball installs as a dependency in a throwaway project, the **host's own**
`bundlePatchPaths`/`loadOverlayPatches` resolve the patch from the installed path, and
`evaluatePluginCompatibility` accepts the installed manifest — with a deliberately
unsatisfiable `engines.dsh` checked alongside it, so the gate cannot pass vacuously. A file
dropped from `files`, or a patch resolved against the wrong directory, fails there and nowhere
else — the other gates read the source tree.

The simulation is not decoration: it caught a real bug, where the measurement path inherited
the digest renderer's 2000-character clamp and priced a 480,000-character message at 1,992
tokens — making the plugin believe an oversized session fit.

`publish:rehearse` closes the last gap that a source-tree test cannot reach: `publish-remote`
is the one step that needs an account, so the rehearsal clones this checkout into a temp
directory, creates a bare repository as the remote, runs the real script against it, and then
asserts what a host would see — the pushed branch, a `market/index.json` that the host's own
`parseMarketIndex` accepts, an entry pinned to the commit that carried the code (not to the
index commit itself), the commit-pinned `git+…#<commit>` install spec, and repository metadata
written into the pushed `package.json`. It needs a full checkout: git refuses to push a shallow
history, so the script says so and exits non-zero instead of pretending to pass (CI checks out
with `fetch-depth: 0`).

## When it does not rescue

Read the plugin's own state instead of guessing. `context_rescue` with
`action: "status"`, or `/rescue-status` in the input box, reports
`measuredTokens`, `window.windowTokens`, `fits`, `foldSupported`, `hostCompaction`,
`toolResultPruner` and `laneBlocked` for the current session.

While the session is over the window, the report also previews the fold it would perform:
how many nodes it would replace and their sequence range, how much history that is in
tokens, how many characters the summary would take, and how much recent history would be
kept. A status call writes nothing — the preview is the same plan `/rescue` would run,
computed and then thrown away.

| Symptom | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| No `armed: context-overflow rescue active` line at startup | the host skipped the bundle | check `engines.dsh` against the app version, and that the patch file resolved inside the installed package |
| `fits: true` yet the provider rejects the request | the window estimate is larger than what the gateway enforces | the failure text usually carries the real number; when it does not, set `windowFallback` to the enforced window |
| `laneBlocked: true` | billion-context refused the host's own compaction on this lane | the plugin stays on the zero-model path; set `zeroModelOnly: true` to make that explicit and stop asking |
| `foldSupported.ok: false` | this session shape does not expose `append`/`surface.nodes`/`eventAt` | a host version mismatch — the plugin refuses to rewrite a projection it cannot re-read |
| `hostCompaction: absent` | no compaction engine is mounted | harmless: tier 2 is skipped and the zero-model ladder still runs |
| the preview says a rescue would find nothing to fold | the overshoot is inside the retained tail and no single message explains it | set `pinFirstUserMessage: false`, or raise `retainRatio` so less of the tail is protected |
| the rescue ran but the request still fails | the payload is still larger than the window | lower `retainRatio`/`retainMaxTokens`, or start a new turn and let the checkpoint carry the gist |

## Limits

- It rescues once the request has failed. If you would rather never see the failure, combine it
  with a preventive compactor; the two do not collide.
- The digest preserves structure and pointers, not every token.
- Marking a proxy lane blocked is per process; restarting the host re-tries it once, on purpose.

## License

MIT.
