evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-model-usage

Provider-account usage for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
sessions. The plugin adds a **Usage** (`用量`) entry to the session header and reports the quota
windows, balance and request counters of the provider account behind the model the conversation is
using.

Queries run in the host process with the provider's own credential reference. The browser receives
normalized values and the credential reference name; credential values never leave the host.

![Usage panel](docs/screenshots/u1.png)

![Usage panel](docs/screenshots/u2.png)

![Usage panel](docs/screenshots/u3.png)

![Usage panel](docs/screenshots/u4.png)

![Usage panel](docs/screenshots/u5.png)

*Usage panel for a Command Code subscription (Chinese UI): five-hour and weekly quota windows,
credit balance, spend, request count, and the model and credential reference used for the query.*

*用量面板：兼容深浅色模式*

Published on npm as [`dsh-model-usage`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-usage).

## Features

- **Session model.** The query target comes from the session's `modelSelection` projection, so the
  panel follows model changes in the conversation.
- **Manual target.** Any routable provider model can be queried from the panel without changing the
  model the conversation runs on.
- **Background refresh.** The mounted component refreshes on an interval, including while the panel
  is closed.
- **Command Code balance history.** The plugin queries on the system clock's ten-minute marks
  (`:00`, `:10`, `:20`, …), independently of the display refresh setting. Samples are kept locally
  per account for the current calendar month and the two preceding calendar months. The chart has
  uniform time-axis ticks, actual sample positions for short ranges, daily totals for week/month
  views, custom start/end dates, and month deletion/reset controls.
- **Provider directory.** The deployment's provider routes are listed with their usage adapter,
  credential reference name and configuration state. Values are never read out.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2` with the Web surface
- Node.js `>=18`
- No runtime dependencies. The browser half requires only the platform `react` module.

## Installation

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-model-usage
```

From an agent session, the bundle can also be installed by name with `install_bundle` (target
`dsh-model-usage`, or the repository path for a local checkout). Both paths install the package into
the profile, mount the bundle patch row `model-usage` and enable the bundle.

With profile HMR enabled, host-side changes apply immediately; otherwise restart the host
(`dsh web` or the desktop application). The browser half is served by `dsh-client-modules` and is
picked up by reloading the page.

## Usage sources

| Provider / base URL | Source | Reported values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `commandcode`, `*.commandcode.ai` | `GET /alpha/whoami?limits=1`, `/alpha/billing/credits`, `/alpha/billing/subscriptions`, `/alpha/usage/summary?since=` | Plan, five-hour and weekly windows, credit balance, spend, request count |
| `deepseek-official`, `deepseek`, `*.deepseek.com` | `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` | Balance per currency |
| `deepseek-account` | `ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance()` | Wallet balances of the signed-in account, without an API key |
| `opencode-go`, `opencode.ai/zen/go` | `GET {origin}/zen/go/v1/usage` | Five-hour, weekly and monthly allowances per model |
| `openrouter`, `*.openrouter.ai` | `GET /api/v1/key`; `GET /api/v1/credits` when the key has no limit of its own | Used, limit, remaining and the account credit pool |
| `moonshotai`, `moonshotai-cn`, `kimi-coding`, `*.moonshot.cn`, `*.moonshot.ai` | `GET /v1/users/me/balance` | Available, cash and voucher balance |
| `siliconflow`, `*.siliconflow.cn`, `*.siliconflow.com` | `GET /v1/user/info` | Total, charged and granted balance |
| Other OpenAI-compatible routes with a `baseURL` | cc-switch New API convention: `GET {origin}/api/user/self` | Quota converted to USD; best effort |

The OpenCode Go endpoint is not publicly documented. Fields are normalized by their common names;
payloads that cannot be recognized remain available under **Raw response**. OpenCode Zen
(pay-as-you-go) has no usage endpoint (`/zen/v1/usage`, `/me` and `/credits` return 404), so
`opencode` routes report that usage queries are not supported. Routes without a `baseURL` and
without a known provider return an explicit error instead of an inferred endpoint.

Adding an adapter requires selecting the route in `kindOf()` and returning normalized data from a
`queryXxx()` function: `{ rows }` for label/value lines or `{ windows, models }` for meters. The
client renders both shapes with the generic card.

## Query target and credentials

1. The browser reads `next ?? lastUsed` from the session's `modelSelection` projection and sends
   `{ provider, model, reasoningEffort, sessionId }` to `POST /model-usage/balance`.
2. If the request carries no target, the host falls back to the session projection of the process
   and then to the deployment default (`agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`).
3. The provider's settings location is resolved through `llm.listConfigurableProviders()` and read
   with `settings.describe()`, which supplies `apiKeyEnv`, `baseURL`, `api` and custom headers.
4. `ctx.credentials.resolve(apiKeyEnv)` returns the key in use. An unconfigured reference falls back
   to the environment variable of the same name; Command Code also falls back to
   `~/.commandcode/auth.json`. Keys are resolved per request, so a key added in Settings → Models is
   used by the next query without a restart.
5. The usage adapter is selected from the provider or base URL.

Providers without `apiKeyEnv` use the convention `${PROVIDER}_API_KEY`; `deepseek-official` uses
`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`.

The panel header shows the active target. `Auto · <provider> / <model>` follows the conversation.
Selecting it opens the model picker with `Auto (follow the conversation)` and the routable provider
models from `sessionController.modelCatalog()`, annotated with their adapter or with
`usage query not supported`. A manual target changes only the panel's query, not the conversation
model, and the credential reference follows the selected provider. The choice is stored in
`dsh-model-usage:model` and can be reset to auto from the panel.

Usage is account-level: models behind the same key share the same quota, so selecting a target
selects the account to query. The panel lists the model and credential reference used.

## Refresh and status

The component queries when it mounts and when the session model changes. With auto-refresh enabled
it continues on an interval whether or not the panel is open.

- The status line reports freshness: `Updated just now`, `Updated 12 min ago`,
  `Refreshing… · showing data from 3 min ago`, or `Not refreshed yet`. A hint is appended when the
  data is older than the interval.
- Auto refresh is toggled from the status line or the refresh settings dialog.
- The interval accepts 1, 5, 15, 30 or 60 minutes, or any value from 1 to 1440. Defaults are enabled
  and five minutes. The policy is stored in `dsh-model-usage:refresh`.
- Opening the panel with data inside the interval does not send a request; **Refresh** forces one.
- A failed query keeps the previous data and appends `Last refresh failed: …`. The full error state
  with **Retry** appears only when no query has succeeded.
- The host applies a 30-second timeout per usage call; the browser applies a 45-second outer timeout.

## Security

- Credential values are read in the host process and are never returned to the browser or written to
  logs. Responses contain normalized values plus the reference name and source.
- All three routes check the composition's browser trust decision (Host/Origin) through the
  `connection` service and answer 401/403 when it is denied.
- The plugin uploads nothing. Usage requests go from the host to the provider API.

## Compatibility

- The bundle declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, `dsh.client` (`platform: web`), `manifestVersion: 1`,
  `engines.dsh` and `engines.node`.
- `locale/zh.json` and `locale/en.json` provide the plugin title and description, and `icon.svg` is
  the icon; both are exported and included in the package.
- The browser half registers `conversation.session.header.utilities`, requires only `react`, and
  addresses the plugin routes with document-relative URLs, so a GUI mounted under a subpath works.
- The host half uses Node built-ins only. `webServer` is the single hard dependency; `connection`,
  `credentials`, `llm`, `settings`, `sessions`, `sessionProjections`, `sessionController`,
  `agentDefaultModel` and `deepseekAccount` are resolved through `ctx.get()` when used, so the
  plugin mounts where those services are optional or activate later.
- Without a locale service, both dictionaries fall back to the Chinese source text.

## Development

```sh
npm run verify   # check + smoke, also runs from prepublishOnly
npm test         # alias for the same suite
```

`scripts/check.mjs` validates the manifest and npm metadata, shipped files, README images, loader
id, baseline module requests, dictionaries, host imports and route registration.
`scripts/smoke.mjs` mounts the host half on a stub context and exercises the three routes, the error
envelopes and the trust fence.

Release:

1. Set `version` according to Semantic Versioning (visible behavior: minor; fixes: patch).
2. Update `CHANGELOG.md`.
3. Run `npm run verify`, then `npm publish`.

Accounts with 2FA publish with `npm publish --otp=<code>`, or authenticate with a Granular Access
Token that allows bypassing 2FA. Keep tokens in the user-level `~/.npmrc`, outside the repository.

## License

MIT. DeepSeek Harness is also MIT-licensed. This is an independent community plugin, not affiliated
with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## 中文

本插件为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 会话提供
当前模型对应供应商账户的用量。它在会话头部增加「用量」入口，显示套餐窗口、余额与请求数；
查询在 host 进程内使用该供应商自己的凭据引用完成，浏览器只收到归一化数值与凭据引用名。

### 功能

- **跟随会话模型**：查询对象取自会话的 `modelSelection` 投影，对话中切换模型时面板随之切换。
- **手动查询对象**：可查询任意可路由的供应商模型，不改变当前对话使用的模型。
- **后台刷新**：已挂载的组件按间隔刷新，弹窗关闭时同样生效。
- **供应商目录**：列出本部署声明的供应商路由、用量适配器、凭据引用名与配置状态，不读取凭据值。

### 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2`，并启用 Web 界面
- Node.js `>=18`
- 无运行时依赖；浏览器半只使用平台提供的 `react` 模块

### 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-model-usage
```

也可在 agent 会话中通过 `install_bundle` 安装（target 为 `dsh-model-usage`，本地开发时传仓库路径）。
两种方式都会把包装入 profile、挂载 bundle patch 的 `model-usage` 行并启用。

启用 profile HMR 时 host 侧改动立即生效；否则重启宿主（`dsh web` 或桌面版）。浏览器半由
`dsh-client-modules` 提供，刷新页面后生效。

### 用量来源

| provider / baseURL | 来源 | 返回值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `commandcode`、`*.commandcode.ai` | `GET /alpha/whoami?limits=1`、`/alpha/billing/credits`、`/alpha/billing/subscriptions`、`/alpha/usage/summary?since=` | 套餐、5 小时 / 7 天窗口、信用余额、已花费、请求数 |
| `deepseek-official`、`deepseek`、`*.deepseek.com` | `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` | 按币种的余额 |
| `deepseek-account` | `ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance()` | 已登录账户的钱包余额（不涉及 API Key） |
| `opencode-go`、`opencode.ai/zen/go` | `GET {origin}/zen/go/v1/usage` | 按模型的 5 小时 / 周 / 月额度 |
| `openrouter`、`*.openrouter.ai` | `GET /api/v1/key`；key 无独立额度时再查 `GET /api/v1/credits` | 已用、额度、剩余与账户额度池 |
| `moonshotai`、`moonshotai-cn`、`kimi-coding`、`*.moonshot.cn`、`*.moonshot.ai` | `GET /v1/users/me/balance` | 可用余额、现金余额、代金券 |
| `siliconflow`、`*.siliconflow.cn`、`*.siliconflow.com` | `GET /v1/user/info` | 总余额、充值余额、赠送余额 |
| 其它带 `baseURL` 的 OpenAI 兼容路由 | cc-switch New API 约定：`GET {origin}/api/user/self` | 按约定换算为 USD，尽力而为 |

OpenCode Go 的端点未公开文档化，字段按常见命名归一化；无法识别的返回保留在「原始返回」中。
OpenCode Zen（按量付费）没有用量接口（`/zen/v1/usage`、`/me`、`/credits` 均为 404），
`opencode` 路由会明确提示不支持用量查询。既无 `baseURL`、也非已知供应商的路由返回明确错误，
不会推断接口。

新增适配器只需在 `kindOf()` 中认领路由，并由 `queryXxx()` 返回归一化数据：`{ rows }` 渲染为
标签值行，`{ windows, models }` 渲染为用量条，客户端统一用通用卡片展示。

### 查询对象与凭据

1. 浏览器读取会话 `modelSelection` 投影的 `next ?? lastUsed`，向 `POST /model-usage/balance`
   发送 `{ provider, model, reasoningEffort, sessionId }`。
2. 请求未携带查询对象时，host 依次回退到本进程的会话投影与部署默认模型
   （`agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`）。
3. host 通过 `llm.listConfigurableProviders()` 取得该 provider 的配置位置，并用
   `settings.describe()` 读取实时配置，得到 `apiKeyEnv`、`baseURL`、`api` 与自定义 headers。
4. `ctx.credentials.resolve(apiKeyEnv)` 取得当前使用的 key。引用未配置时回退到同名环境变量；
   Command Code 还会回退到 `~/.commandcode/auth.json`。解析在每次查询时进行，因此
   「设置 → 模型」中新填的 key 无需重启即可用于下一次查询。
5. 按 provider 或 baseURL 选择用量适配器。

未声明 `apiKeyEnv` 的 provider 按 `${PROVIDER}_API_KEY` 约定推导引用名，`deepseek-official`
使用 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。

面板顶部显示当前查询对象。`自动 · <provider> / <model>` 跟随对话；点击后可在模型选择器中选择
`自动（跟随当前对话）`，或选择 `sessionController.modelCatalog()` 中任意可路由模型（标注其适配器
或「不支持用量查询」）。手动选择只改变面板的查询对象，不改变对话模型，凭据引用随所选供应商切换；
选择保存在 `dsh-model-usage:model`，可在面板中改回自动。

用量是账户级数据：同一把 key 下的模型共享同一份额度，因此切换查询对象即切换要查询的账户。
面板底部列出本次查询使用的模型与凭据引用。

### 刷新与状态

组件在挂载时与会话模型变化时查询。开启自动刷新后，无论弹窗是否打开，都会按间隔继续查询。

- 状态行显示数据新鲜度：`刷新时间：刚刚`、`刷新时间：12 分钟前`、
  `刷新中… · 当前显示 3 分钟前数据`、`尚未刷新`；数据超过刷新间隔时会追加提示。
- 自动刷新可在状态行或刷新设置中开关。
- 刷新间隔支持 1 / 5 / 15 / 30 / 60 分钟，也可填写 1–1440 之间的任意分钟数；默认开启、间隔
  5 分钟。策略保存在 `dsh-model-usage:refresh`。
- 数据仍在间隔内时打开面板不会发起请求；「刷新」按钮可强制查询。
- 查询失败时保留上次数据并追加 `上次刷新失败：…`；仅在从未成功时显示整屏错误与「重试」。
- Command Code 余额历史独立于面板刷新开关，在系统时间的每小时 `00 / 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50`
  分自动查询。数据按账户保存在浏览器本地，保留当前自然月及前两个月；例如十月会保留十月、
  九月、八月，七月数据自动清除。用量卡片提供「今天 / 昨天 / 近一周 / 近一月 / 自定义」筛选，
  周和月按每天合计，短时间段按真实查询时间定位折线点，并可清除指定月份或重置当前账户记录。
  首次记录作为余额基线，后续每段消耗按前后余额差计算，余额增加时该段显示为零。
- host 侧单次用量请求超时 30 秒，浏览器侧另有 45 秒外层超时。

### 安全

- 凭据值只在 host 进程内读取，不返回浏览器，也不写入日志；响应仅包含归一化数值、引用名与来源。
- 三条路由在应答前通过 `connection` 服务校验浏览器信任（Host/Origin），未通过时返回 401/403。
- 插件不上传任何数据，用量请求由 host 直接发往供应商接口。

### 兼容性

- bundle 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`、`dsh.client`（`platform: web`）、`manifestVersion: 1`、
  `engines.dsh` 与 `engines.node`。
- `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` 提供插件标题与描述，`icon.svg` 为图标；两者都已导出并包含在包内。
- 浏览器半注册 `conversation.session.header.utilities`，只依赖 `react`，并使用文档相对路径访问
  插件路由，因此 GUI 挂在子目录下同样可用。
- host 半只使用 Node 内置模块。`webServer` 是唯一硬依赖；`connection`、`credentials`、`llm`、
  `settings`、`sessions`、`sessionProjections`、`sessionController`、`agentDefaultModel`、
  `deepseekAccount` 均按需通过 `ctx.get()` 获取，服务缺失或稍后激活时插件仍可挂载。
- 没有 locale 服务时，词典回退为中文原文。

### 开发

```sh
npm run verify   # check + smoke，prepublishOnly 同样执行
npm test         # 同一套检查的别名
```

`scripts/check.mjs` 校验清单与 npm 元数据、随包文件、README 图片、loader id、基线模块、
词典、host 导入与路由注册；`scripts/smoke.mjs` 在桩 ctx 上挂载 host 半，覆盖三条路由、
错误响应与信任栅栏。

发布流程：

1. 按语义化版本更新 `version`（可见行为变化为 minor，修复为 patch）。
2. 更新 `CHANGELOG.md`。
3. 运行 `npm run verify`，然后执行 `npm publish`。

启用 2FA 的账号可用 `npm publish --otp=<验证码>` 发布，或使用允许绕过 2FA 的 Granular Access
Token 认证。令牌只保存在用户级 `~/.npmrc`，不要提交到仓库。

### 许可

MIT。DeepSeek Harness 同样以 MIT 许可发布。本项目为独立社区插件，与深度求索公司无隶属或背书关系。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-ssh-safe

> Security-first SSH tools for DeepSeek Harness. No telemetry, no cloud, no
> auto-update, no host patching. Credentials from environment variables by default.

**v0.2.0** · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) · MIT

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

---

## 中文

### 这个插件解决什么问题

让 DSH Agent 能操作远程 Linux 服务器（跑命令、读写文件、列目录），**同时不把你的服务器凭据交给任何第三方**。

### 设计约束（为什么值得信任）

这个插件存在的理由是：同类插件普遍做了下面这些事，而它**一件都不做**。

| 常见做法 | dsh-ssh-safe |
| --- | --- |
| 上报安装心跳到某个云函数 | **无任何遥测**。全包没有 HTTP 客户端，`grep -r 'fetch(' src/` 结果为空 |
| 自动检查并热替换自身代码 | **无自动更新**。从不拉取版本，从不改写自己 |
| 修改 `app.asar` 内的 DSH 源文件 | **不碰宿主**。`cordis.patch.yml` 只 `insert` 自己一条 |
| 禁用 `fs-sandbox` / `bash-sandbox` | **不禁用**。本地沙箱保持原样 |
| 把密码写进 `cordis.patch.yml` 明文 | **不落盘**。默认只从环境变量读取 |

## 兼容性要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0`（见 `package.json` 的 `dsh.engines.dsh`） |
| Node.js | `>=20` |
| 目标主机 | 运行中的 `sshd`。`ssh_list`/SFTP 需要 sshd 启用 sftp 子系统（现代发行版默认开启） |
| 工具注册 API | 自动适配：`ctx.tools.register`（0.2.1+）与 `ctx.tools.defineTool`（0.1.x）。两者都没有时以版本提示拒绝加载，而不是静默消失 |
| 认证 | 密码、私钥文件、或 SSH agent（`SSH_AUTH_SOCK`）三者之一 |

不需要在目标主机上安装任何东西，也不需要 Python、Node 或 `ripgrep`。

### 已知限制

- **长任务**：`commandTimeoutMs` 默认 30 秒，超时会向远端发送 `TERM`。跑训练、`apt upgrade` 这类长任务需要显式提高 `timeoutMs`。
- **不支持二进制传输**：`ssh_read`/`ssh_write` 只处理 UTF-8 文本，单次上限 `maxFileBytes`（默认 1 MB）。
- **不支持端口转发 / 跳板机 / 多机批量**：设计上只做「安全地跑命令和读写文件」。
- **`denyPatterns` 是安全带，不是边界**：它能挡住手滑和常见的包装写法，但 shell 是图灵完备的。真正的隔离属于远端账号权限。

### 安装

尚未发布到 npm。用 git 或本地路径安装，然后重启 DSH：

```sh
# 从 GitHub
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ljk00000/dsh-ssh-safe

# 或从本地克隆
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/dsh-ssh-safe
```

> **本地 `file:` 安装的坑**：pnpm 不会重新拷贝后来新增的文件。改了源码后如果加了新文件,
> 必须先 `remove` 再 `add`，否则插件会因 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` 崩溃。
> （`test/installed.test.js` 就是为了逮住这种情况。)

## 三种配置来源（密码经常变化时看这里）

机器可以从三个地方定义，各有用途：

| 来源 | 适合放什么 | 改了要重启吗 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **设置界面** `machines.<别名>` | host / port / user / 私钥路径 / 主机密钥策略 | 需要重载插件 |
| **凭据文件** `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh-safe/credentials.json` | 密码、私钥口令（**DPAPI 加密**） | **不用，下次连接即生效** |
| **环境变量** `DSH_SSH_<别名>_*` | CI、不想落盘的场景 | 需要重启 DSH |

优先级：**设置界面 > 凭据文件 > 环境变量 > SSH agent**。
空值不参与比较，所以设置界面留空不会遮蔽环境变量。

## 图形界面（按需打开，用完即退出）

```bash
cd <插件目录>
node scripts/gui.mjs
```

会自动打开浏览器页面，可以：

- 看到所有机器（凭据文件 + 环境变量 + DSH 设置里定义的）
- 填 host / 端口 / 用户 / 私钥路径
- **填入密码 → 立即 DPAPI 加密**，磁盘上不留明文
- **点「测试连接」** → 依次报告 配置 / TCP / 主机密钥 / 认证 / 命令通道
- 点「删除」移除某个别名

### 它不是常驻服务

| 设计 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| **独立进程**，不是插件里的服务 | 插件保持「不开端口」的定位 |
| 只绑 `127.0.0.1`，随机端口 | 外部无法访问 |
| 每次启动随机 token，URL 里带 | 本机其它程序无法驱动它 |
| 关闭页面 / 闲置 10 分钟即退出 | 不留后台进程 |
| 页面单文件、无 CDN、无遥测 | 不联网 |

### 测试连接不改变信任状态

页面上的「测试连接」只**报告**主机指纹，不会写入 known_hosts。
正式连接仍需 `ssh_connect`（首次可传 `trustHostKey: true`）——测试工具不应该改动被测试对象的状态。

> 密码在页面里输入 → 传到本地进程 → 立刻 DPAPI 加密 → 写入文件。
> 全程没有明文落盘，也没有任何接口会把密码返回给页面。
### 改密码（命令行方式）

```bash
cd <插件目录>
node scripts/set-password.mjs --alias gpu
```

它会提示你输入密码（**不回显、不进 shell 历史、不进对话记录**），用 **Windows DPAPI 加密**后
写入 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh-safe/credentials.json`，并把文件 ACL 限制到「你 + SYSTEM」。

**下一条命令就是新密码，不用重启 DSH。**

也可以一次把机器信息写进去（这样连环境变量都不用配）：

```bash
node scripts/set-password.mjs --alias gpu \
  --host gpu.example.com --port 2222 --user root
```

用私钥 + 口令：

```bash
node scripts/set-password.mjs --alias prod \
  --key-path ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 --key-passphrase
```

> 为什么不提供 `.ps1`：这台机器的 PowerShell 执行策略会拒绝未签名脚本。
> Node 脚本不受该策略影响，而插件本来就依赖 Node。
### 密码怎么存：磁盘上没有明文

| 方式 | 磁盘上是什么 | 安全边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 凭据文件（默认） | **DPAPI 密文** | 只有你这一个 Windows 账户能解开；文件复制到别的机器或别的用户下解不开 |
| 环境变量 | 不落盘 | 只存在于启动 DSH 的那个进程内存里 |
| SSH agent | 不落盘 | 私钥在 agent 里，插件只拿到签名 |
| 设置界面 / 明文文件 | 明文 | **默认被拒绝** |

所以：**插件默认不读明文密码**。如果在设置界面或凭据文件里写了明文，连接会失败并给出
说明（`ssh_doctor` 会显示 `[warn]`）。要强行接受明文，设 `allowPlaintextPassword: true`——但那就等于
放弃这层保护。

### 没有 DPAPI 的平台（Linux / macOS）

凭据文件只支持 DPAPI 加密，所以这些平台请用**环境变量**或 **SSH agent**：

```bash
export DSH_SSH_PROD_PASSWORD='...'   # 只在当前进程内存里
```

或者把公钥加到服务器后改用私钥 —— 私钥有口令也只会进 DPAPI 加密的口令字段。
### 推荐用法

1. 在 DSH 设置里给插件加一个机器条目（“机器”很少变）：

```
machines.prod = { host: "10.0.0.5", port: 22, user: "ubuntu" }
```

2. 密码放进凭据文件（“密码”经常变）：

```bash
# ~/.dsh/dsh-ssh-safe/credentials.json
{
  "prod": { "password": "..." },
  "gpu":  { "keyPath": "~/.ssh/id_ed25519", "keyPassphrase": "..." }
}
```

改完不用重启——插件每次连接都会重新读这个文件。

### 查看当前生效的是什么

```
ssh_credentials    # 每台机器的密码/密钥来自哪里（只报来源，不显示值）
ssh_config         # 插件配置 + 凭据文件路径
ssh_machines       # 机器清单 + 每个字段的来源
```

> **密码要不要写进设置界面？** 可以，但设置界面的内容会以明文存进 DSH 的配置文件。
> 凭据文件是独立文件、权限 0600、改动即时生效，更适合经常轮换的密码。

### 安全提醒

- 凭据文件在 Windows 上无法设置 POSIX 权限（`chmod` 无效果），请确保它位于只有你能访问的用户目录。
- 目录已通过 `.gitignore` 排除，不会被误提交。

### 配置服务器凭据（环境变量方式）

用一个「别名 + 环境变量」的方式。别名只能用字母、数字、点、下划线、连字符
（字母会被转成大写用于变量名：`prod.x` 读的是 `DSH_SSH_PROD_X_HOST`）。别名 `prod` 对应下面这些变量：

```sh
DSH_SSH_PROD_HOST=10.0.0.5
DSH_SSH_PROD_PORT=22
DSH_SSH_PROD_USER=ubuntu
DSH_SSH_PROD_KEY_PATH=~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```

或用密码代替密钥：

```sh
DSH_SSH_PROD_PASSWORD=...
```

可选：

```sh
DSH_SSH_PROD_KEY_PASSPHRASE=...      # 加密私钥的口令
DSH_SSH_PROD_HOST_KEY_POLICY=tofu    # strict（默认）/ tofu / off
DSH_SSH_PROD_KNOWN_HOSTS=~/.ssh/known_hosts.json
```

设置完**重启 DSH**——环境变量在进程启动时读取，不会热加载。

### 我该用哪个工具

| 情况 | 用这个 |
| --- | --- |
| 不知道有哪些机器 | `ssh_machines` |
| 连不上，不知道为什么 | **`ssh_doctor`**（分级诊断，先说清卡在哪一步） |
| 只是想建立连接 | `ssh_connect` |
| 跑命令 | `ssh_exec` |
| 改配置文件 | `ssh_read` 看清现状 → `ssh_write` 改 |
| 看目录里有什么 | `ssh_list` |
| 怀疑有异常操作，想复盘 | **`ssh_audit`**（需要先开 `auditLog: true`） |
| 某个设置不生效 | **`ssh_config`**（显示运行时实际生效的配置） |
| 手动断开 | `ssh_close` |

排障顺序永远是 **`ssh_machines` → `ssh_doctor` → 具体操作**。​`ssh_doctor` 把失败分成
配置 / 凭据 / TCP / 主机密钥 / 认证五级，比一句「认证失败」有用得多。​

### 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `ssh_machines` | 列出已配置的机器、认证方式、指纹信任状态（**不显示任何密钥**） |
| `ssh_connect` | 建立或复用连接，返回主机指纹与远端 `uname` |
| `ssh_exec` | 在远端执行命令，返回 stdout / stderr / 退出码 |
| `ssh_read` | 读远端文件（UTF-8，按字节上限截断；默认对疑似密钥打码，`raw: true` 关闭） |
| `ssh_write` | 写远端文件（覆盖）；父目录不存在时报错，`createDirs: true` 自动创建 |
| `ssh_list` | 列远端目录（超过 `maxListEntries` 截断并说明略过多少条） |
| `ssh_close` | 关闭连接（有命令在跑会拒绝，除非 `force: true`） |
| `ssh_doctor` | 分级诊断：配置 / 凭据 / TCP / 主机密钥 / 认证 |
| `ssh_audit` | 查看操作记录（需 `auditLog: true`） |
| `ssh_config` | 查看运行时实际生效的配置 |
| `ssh_credentials` | 查看凭据来源与优先级（只报来源，永不打印值） |
| `ssh_workspace` | 创建 / 列出 / 移除**远程工作区**：侧栏里一个绑定到某台 SSH 主机的工作区 |

### 远程工作区（侧栏）

DSH 的工作区是一个**本地目录**：注册表按路径归组会话，agent 的工作目录就是它。
远端主机没有本地目录，所以本插件用一个**占位目录**代表它：

```
~/.dsh/dsh-ssh-safe/remotes/<alias>/
  AGENTS.md                    ← agent 自动读取的说明
  .dsh-remote-workspace.json   ← 别名、主机、端口、生成时间
```

把这个目录注册成工作区，它就会出现在左侧「工作区」列表里（标题是 `远程 · <alias>`）。
在这个工作区里新开会话时，DSH 会自动把 `AGENTS.md` 当作项目指令加载；指令告诉模型：
这个目录只是指针，所有文件与命令操作都必须走 `ssh_*` 工具并带上 `machine: "<alias>"`。

```
ssh_workspace { action: "create", machine: "gpu" }   # 创建并注册
ssh_workspace { }                                     # 列出状态
ssh_workspace { action: "remove", machine: "gpu" }    # 从侧栏移除（保留占位目录）
ssh_workspace { action: "remove", machine: "gpu", deleteFiles: true }
```

创建后侧栏若没立刻刷新，按 F5 重载页面。占位目录里**没有任何凭据**，也没有远端文件；
主机或端口变了（例如换了个端口）再执行一次 `create` 即可刷新 `AGENTS.md`。

需要说清楚的边界：这是**绑定**，不是挂载。本地 `pwsh` / `read` / `write` 仍然只看得到本机，
它们不会因为会话在这个工作区里就变成远端执行——这正是 `AGENTS.md` 要反复强调的原因。

### 主机密钥校验

默认 `strict`：**只有已记录过指纹的主机才能连**。首次连接需要显式确认：

```
ssh_connect { machine: "prod", trustHostKey: true }
```

指纹会存进 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh-safe/known_hosts.json`（权限 0600），内容只有主机、端口、指纹——**没有用户名、密码、密钥**。

如果服务器的指纹**变了**，插件会拒绝连接并说明原因，而不是自动接受。这是防中间人攻击的核心行为。

每台机器可以用 `DSH_SSH_<ALIAS>_HOST_KEY_POLICY` **单独覆盖**全局策略（收紧或放宽都行）：

```sh
DSH_SSH_PROD_HOST_KEY_POLICY=strict   # 这台机器强制 strict，即使全局是 tofu
```

### `ssh_list` 的路径语义

`ssh_list` 允许相对路径（默认 `.`），但**拒绝含 `..` 的相对路径**：
SFTP 把相对路径解析到登录目录，而插件无从知道那是哪里（取决于 sshd 配置和账号类型）。
让 `../etc` 在猜测的基准上解析，不如直接要求绝对路径。

### 可选：`ssh_read` 的脱敏

`ssh_read` 默认会把你读到的内容里的密钥样式文本替换成 `<redacted>`——
因为读 `.env` 或配置文件正是密码最容易流进对话记录的路径。

需要看原文时传 `raw: true`：

```
ssh_read { machine: "prod", path: "/opt/app/.env", raw: true }
```

### 可选：隐藏主机拓扑

`ssh_machines` 默认显示 `user@host:port` 和私钥路径。
如果会话记录可能被分享或导出，改成只显示别名：

```yaml
- id: dsh-ssh-safe
  name: 'dsh-ssh-safe'
  config:
    machineInventory: alias    # 隐藏 host / port / 私钥路径
```

### 连接上限

最多保活 8 条连接，超出时关闭最久未使用的（LRU）。
配了很多机器时不会无限累积 socket：

```yaml
    maxConnections: 8    # 0 = 不限制
```

### 并发

十二个工具都声明了自己可以并发执行：每次调用走独立的 SSH 通道，连接池按别名复用。
所以在同一台机器上同时跑两个命令、或者一边跑命令一边读文件都不会互相排队。
（少了这个声明，DSH 会把工具当作独占资源：一条 3 秒的命令会让另一条 0.2 秒的命令也等 3 秒。）

### 可选：允许在会话里传密码

默认关闭。开启方式（在 profile 的插件配置里）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-ssh-safe
  name: 'dsh-ssh-safe'
  config:
    allowSessionPassword: true
```

开启后可以用 `ssh_connect { machine: "prod", password: "..." }`。**代价**：密码会进入对话记录（transcript）。这就是为什么它默认关闭。

会话密码是**最后顺位**：设置界面、凭据文件、环境变量都优先于它。如果其中任意一个已提供，传进来的密码不会被使用，调用结果会附一行 `[note]` 说明——避免“存着的旧密码登录成功”被误读成“新密码生效”。

### 可选：执行前确认

```yaml
- id: dsh-ssh-safe
  name: 'dsh-ssh-safe'
  config:
    execGuard: confirm     # ssh_exec 必须带 confirm: true 才会执行
```

防止模型自作主张跑命令。

### 危险命令拦截

默认拒绝这些模式（可配置，共 9 条）：

- `rm -rf /` 及其变体：`//`、`/*`、`/.`、`/..`
- `rm -rf ~` / `rm -rf $HOME`（家目录顶层）
- `cd /`（或 `cd ~`）之后紧跟 `rm -rf *`——斜杠在 cd 里，第一条看不见
- `find /` 配合 `-delete` 或 `-exec rm`
- `mkfs.*`、`dd if=... of=/dev/sd*`、fork 炸弹
- `shutdown` / `reboot` / `halt` / `poweroff`，且只在**命令位置**匹配（`grep -c shutdown 日志` 不再被误拦）

**注意**：这是防手滑的安全带，不是安全边界。shell 总有别的路径可达。
默认规则只匹配命令的开头与结尾各 8 KB，避免病态超长输入把检查拖成平方级；
真实命令远短于这个窗口。


### 可选：原生加速绑定（`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`）

`ssh2` 带两个**可选**原生模块：`cpu-features`（CPU 特性探测）和 `sshcrypto`（更快的加密）。
不编译它们插件照样能用（纯 JS 回退），但 pnpm 会把「忽略构建脚本」当成错误，让安装以非零码退出。

遇到这个报错时，在 profile 目录跑一次：

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm approve-builds --all
```

注意必须用**与 DSH 相同的大版本** pnpm。DSH 内置的是 pnpm 11，
如果你系统里的 `pnpm` 是 10，就要用 `npx pnpm@11 approve-builds --all`，
否则 `node_modules` 的 store 标记会被改写，之后 `dsh plugin` 会报 `ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE`。


### 开发与测试

- `npm test` —— 全部离线测试（近 500 个，不需要任何主机）
- `npm run typecheck` —— `tsc --noEmit`
- `npm run test:loopback` —— 在本机起一个内存中的 SSH/SFTP 服务端，把
  `test/integration.test.js` 那几条「真主机」用例跑一遍
- `DSH_SSH_TEST_TARGET=<别名> npm test` —— 对着真实主机跑同一组用例
  （照常设置 `DSH_SSH_<别名>_HOST` / `_USER` / `_PASSWORD` 或 `_KEY_PATH`）

loopback 服务端不执行命令、不碰磁盘，只按脚本回包——它验证的是客户端这一半：
握手、主机密钥、exec 通道、SFTP 读写与超时。

### 配置默认值一览

| 配置项 | 默认 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hostKeyPolicy` | `strict` | 只连已记录指纹的主机 |
| `execGuard` | `allow` | `confirm` 时 `ssh_exec` 和 `ssh_write` 都必须带 `confirm: true` |
| `allowSessionPassword` | `false` | 是否允许在会话里传密码 |
| `allowPlaintextPassword` | `false` | 是否接受凭据文件或设置界面里的明文密码（默认只认 DPAPI 加密值） |
| `machineInventory` | `full` | `alias` 时隐藏 host/port/私钥路径 |
| `auditLog` | `false` | 是否记录操作到 NDJSON |
| `maxConnections` | `8` | 常驻连接上限，LRU 淘汰，`0` 不限制 |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 单条命令超时 |
| `sftpTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 单次传输超时 |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | `15000` | 建立连接超时 |
| `closeTimeoutMs` | `1500` | 等待对端确认关闭 |
| `keepaliveIntervalMs` | `20000` | SSH keepalive，`0` 关闭 |
| `maxOutputChars` | `200000` | stdout + stderr 合计上限 |
| `maxFileBytes` | `1048576` | 单次传输字节上限 |
| `maxListEntries` | `2000` | `ssh_list` 单次输出的行数上限，`0` 不限制 |
| `reconnectCooldownMs` | `15000` | 失败后冷却，期间可用 `force: true` 绕过 |
| `healthCheckIdleMs` | `300000` | 空闲多久后复用前先探活，`0` 关闭 |
| `defaultMachine` | `''` | 工具调用省略 `machine` 时使用的别名 |
| `machines` | `{}` | 机器定义（设置界面可编辑，不含密码优先） |
| `useCredentialFile` | `true` | 每次连接读取凭据文件，改密码免重启 |
| `healthCheckTimeoutMs` | `3000` | 探活探测的截止时间 |
| `pipeToShell` | `refuse` | `refuse` 拦截管道进解释器；`allow` 放行 |
| `denyPatterns` | 9 条 | 危险命令拦截（安全带，不是边界） |

### 它不做什么

- 不接管 `ctx.fs` / `ctx.shell`。你本地的 `read` / `write` / `bash` 完全不受影响
- 不提供端口转发、跳板机、SFTP 目录同步、远程界面
- 不读 `~/.ssh/config`（需要显式设环境变量）

想要这些功能，`dsh-remote` 更全。本插件只做「安全地跑命令和读写文件」。

---

## English

### What this solves

Gives a DeepSeek Harness agent the ability to work on a remote Linux server
(run commands, read/write files, list directories) **without handing server
credentials to a third party**.

### Design constraints

| What similar plugins do | What dsh-ssh-safe does |
| --- | --- |
| POST an install heartbeat to a cloud function | **No telemetry.** The package contains no HTTP client; `grep -r 'fetch(' src/` is empty |
| Check for and hot-swap its own code | **No auto-update.** Never fetches a version, never rewrites itself |
| Patch DeepSeek Harness files inside `app.asar` | **No host patching.** `cordis.patch.yml` only inserts this plugin |
| Disable `fs-sandbox` / `bash-sandbox` | **Leaves them alone.** Local sandboxing is unchanged |
| Store the SSH password in plaintext config | **Never persisted.** Environment variables by default |

### Compatibility

| Item | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0` (see `dsh.engines.dsh` in `package.json`) |
| Node.js | `>=20` (declared as `engines.node`) |
| Target host | a running `sshd`; `ssh_list`/SFTP need the sftp subsystem (on by default on modern distros) |
| Tool registration API | Detected at load: `ctx.tools.register` (0.2.1+) or `ctx.tools.defineTool` (0.1.x); with neither, the plugin refuses to load with a version-naming error instead of vanishing |
| Auth | password, private key file, or SSH agent (`SSH_AUTH_SOCK`) |

Nothing needs to be installed on the target host — no Python, no Node, no `ripgrep`.

### Known limitations

- **Long-running tasks**: `commandTimeoutMs` defaults to 30 s and sends `TERM` on expiry. Training runs, `apt upgrade` and the like need an explicit higher `timeoutMs`.
- **No binary transfer**: `ssh_read`/`ssh_write` handle UTF-8 text only, capped at `maxFileBytes` (1 MB by default).
- **No port forwarding, jump hosts or fleet-wide fan-out**: by design this only runs commands and moves files, safely.
- **`denyPatterns` is a seatbelt, not a boundary**: it stops slips and the common wrapper spellings, but the shell is Turing-complete. Real isolation belongs to the remote account's permissions.

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ssh-safe
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards.

### Configure a machine

Alias `prod` maps to these environment variables:

```sh
DSH_SSH_PROD_HOST=10.0.0.5
DSH_SSH_PROD_PORT=22
DSH_SSH_PROD_USER=ubuntu
DSH_SSH_PROD_KEY_PATH=~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```

Or a password instead of a key:

```sh
DSH_SSH_PROD_PASSWORD=...
```

Optional:

```sh
DSH_SSH_PROD_KEY_PASSPHRASE=...      # passphrase for an encrypted key
DSH_SSH_PROD_HOST_KEY_POLICY=tofu    # strict (default) / tofu / off
DSH_SSH_PROD_KNOWN_HOSTS=~/.ssh/known_hosts.json
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness — environment variables are read at process start.

### Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `ssh_machines` | Configured machines, auth kind, fingerprint trust (never shows key material) |
| `ssh_connect` | Open/reuse a connection; reports fingerprint and remote `uname` |
| `ssh_exec` | Run a command; returns stdout, stderr, exit code |
| `ssh_read` | Read a remote file (UTF-8, byte-capped; secret-shaped text masked unless `raw: true`) |
| `ssh_write` | Write a remote file (overwrite); `createDirs: true` creates missing parents |
| `ssh_list` | List a remote directory (capped by `maxListEntries`) |
| `ssh_close` | Close connections |
| `ssh_doctor` | Stage-by-stage diagnosis, including a real authentication attempt |
| `ssh_audit` | Recent operations (requires `auditLog: true`) |
| `ssh_config` | The configuration actually in effect |
| `ssh_credentials` | Credential sources and precedence (never values) |
| `ssh_workspace` | Create, list or remove a **remote workspace**: a sidebar workspace bound to one SSH machine |

### Concurrency

All twelve tools declare themselves concurrency-safe: every call owns its own SSH
channel and the pool reuses one connection per alias, so two commands on the same
machine, or a command and a read, run at the same time instead of queueing.
Without that declaration the harness treats a tool as an exclusive resource — one
3-second command made an unrelated 0.2-second command wait 3 seconds.

### Remote workspaces (sidebar)

A DSH workspace is a **local directory**: the registry groups sessions by path and
the agent's working directory is that path. A remote host has no local directory,
so the plugin uses a placeholder directory to stand for it:

```
~/.dsh/dsh-ssh-safe/remotes/<alias>/
  AGENTS.md                    ← instructions the agent loads automatically
  .dsh-remote-workspace.json   ← alias, host, port, when it was generated
```

Registering that directory makes it a normal workspace in the sidebar, titled
`远程 · <alias>`. A session started there loads `AGENTS.md` as project
instructions, and those instructions say the directory is only a pointer: every
file or command operation goes through the `ssh_*` tools with
`machine: "<alias>"`.

```
ssh_workspace { action: "create", machine: "gpu" }   # create and register
ssh_workspace { }                                     # show status
ssh_workspace { action: "remove", machine: "gpu" }    # unregister, keep the directory
ssh_workspace { action: "remove", machine: "gpu", deleteFiles: true }
```

Reload the page (F5) if the sidebar has not picked up the new workspace. The
placeholder holds no credential and no remote file; re-run `create` after an
endpoint change to refresh `AGENTS.md`.

The boundary worth stating: this is a **binding**, not a mount. Local
`pwsh` / `read` / `write` still see only this machine — they do not become
remote just because the session lives in that workspace, which is exactly why
`AGENTS.md` repeats the rule.

### Host key verification

`strict` by default: only hosts already recorded may connect. First contact
requires an explicit `trustHostKey: true` on `ssh_connect`.

Fingerprints are stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh-safe/known_hosts.json` (mode 0600)
and contain host, port and fingerprint only — never a username, password or key.

A **changed** host key fails the connection with an explanation rather than
being accepted. That is the whole point of host verification.

### Opt-in: password from the conversation

Off by default. Enable it in the profile plugin config:

```yaml
- id: dsh-ssh-safe
  name: 'dsh-ssh-safe'
  config:
    allowSessionPassword: true
```

Then `ssh_connect { machine: "prod", password: "..." }` works. The trade-off:
the password enters the conversation transcript. That is why it is off.

A session password is the **last resort**: the settings form, the credential
file and the environment all outrank it. If one of those is present the supplied
password is not used, and the call says so with a `[note]` line rather than
letting a stale stored credential look like a successful login.

### Opt-in: confirm before exec

```yaml
- id: dsh-ssh-safe
  name: 'dsh-ssh-safe'
  config:
    execGuard: confirm
```

`ssh_exec` then requires `confirm: true`, so a model cannot run commands purely
on its own initiative.

### Denied command patterns

Nine patterns ship by default:

- `rm -rf /` and its spellings `//`, `/*`, `/.`, `/..`
- `rm -rf ~` / `rm -rf $HOME` (the top of the home directory)
- `cd /` (or `cd ~`) followed by `rm -rf *` — the slash lives in the `cd`, so
  the first rule cannot see it
- `find /` with `-delete` or `-exec rm`
- `mkfs.*`, `dd if=... of=/dev/sd*`, fork bombs
- `shutdown`/`reboot`/`halt`/`poweroff`, matched only in **command position**
  (`grep -c shutdown syslog` is no longer refused)

Patterns are matched against the first and last 8 KB of a command, so a
pathological input cannot make the check quadratic. A real command is far
shorter than that window.

A safety rail against catastrophic typos — **not** a security boundary.

### Tests

- `npm test` — the whole offline suite (close to 500 tests; no host needed)
- `npm run typecheck` — `tsc --noEmit`
- `npm run test:loopback` — starts an in-memory SSH/SFTP server on this machine
  and runs the "real host" cases in `test/integration.test.js` against it
- `DSH_SSH_TEST_TARGET=<alias> npm test` — the same cases against a real host
  (with `DSH_SSH_<ALIAS>_HOST` / `_USER` / `_PASSWORD` or `_KEY_PATH` set as usual)

The loopback server runs no process and touches no disk; it answers from a
script. It proves the client half — handshake, host key, exec channel, SFTP
reads and writes, deadlines.

### Not included

Port forwarding, bastion/jump hosts, SFTP mirroring, remote web UI. It also
does not read `~/.ssh/config` (set environment variables explicitly).

Use `dsh-remote` if you need those.

---

## License

MIT

Remote execution and configurable pipe-to-shell behavior therefore remain held for execution-policy acceptance. No install lifecycle hook is declared. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-whale-memory

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的**主动记忆**插件。

不是「用户提线索才去捞」的检索器——它会察觉情绪，主动想起相关旧事；闲着的时候还会自己胡思乱想，把念头也存进记忆。

```
最近几轮的对话：
用户: 今天好累 → 你: 怎么个累法？

主动想起的相关旧事（因情绪(tired)相关而取用）：
1. 〔印象深刻〕用户: 最近天天加班，累死了 → 你: 辛苦了
```

## 它和别的记忆插件有什么不同

大多数记忆插件的逻辑是：**用户提到线索 → 检索 → 注入**。本质是个检索器。

这个插件的逻辑是：

1. **情绪驱动**：识别五类情绪（累 / 难过 / 气 / 开心 / 焦虑），情绪吻合的记忆强加权
2. **主动联想**：真向量余弦 + 情绪 + 累积权重 + 新近度综合打分，**不等用户给线索**
3. **记忆合并**：低权重的按相似度压成摘要，高权重（≥ 8）原地不动——像人一样遗忘，但记住印象深的
4. **胡思乱想**：定时器拉起，随机挑冷区记忆做向量配对，生出联想写回库中，加噪声

## 三个技术选择

| 项 | 选择 | 理由 |
|---|---|---|
| 存储 | `node:sqlite`（Node 26 内置） | 零依赖，向量存 Float32 BLOB，单机够用 |
| 向量 | 本地 BGE-small-zh-v1.5 int8 ONNX | 24MB，512 维，中文专用，离线运行 |
| 后台 | systemd timer（非常驻进程） | 只在触发时算，几乎零开销 |

向量服务不可用时**自动降级**到字符二元组重叠度，绝不阻塞对话。

## 安装

### 前置：向量服务

需要一份 BGE 中文嵌入模型（ONNX 格式，含 `model.onnx` 和 `tokenizer.json`）。

本项目默认路径：

```
/usr/share/miyu/models/bge-small-zh-v1.5-int8/
```

换路径改 `embed_server.py` 里的 `MODEL_DIR`，或用 `EMBED_PORT` 环境变量改端口。

```bash
# 装依赖（用 uv 装到隔离目录，不污染系统 python）
UV_CACHE_DIR=~/.cache/uv uv pip install --target ~/.local/share/dsh-whale/pylibs onnxruntime numpy

# 起服务
PYTHONPATH=~/.local/share/dsh-whale/pylibs python3 embed_server.py
```

做成 systemd 用户服务（`~/.config/systemd/user/dsh-whale-embed.service`）：

```ini
[Unit]
Description=Whale Memory Embedding Service

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/path/to/dsh-whale-memory
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/home/you/.local/share/dsh-whale/pylibs
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /path/to/dsh-whale-memory/embed_server.py
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
```

```bash
systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now dsh-whale-embed
curl http://127.0.0.1:8377/health   # {"ok":true,"dims":512,...}
```

### 插件本体

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-whale-memory
```

如果是手工安装（`dsh plugin add` 走 pnpm 时可能被其它依赖的 registry 问题卡住）：

```bash
cp -r dsh-whale-memory ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/
```

然后把它加进 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组，重启 dsh。

> **注意**：`package.json` 里必须有 `dsh.bundle.patch` 字段，否则 `dsh --dump-config` 会报
> `declares no dsh.bundle in its package.json`。

### 胡思乱想（可选）

```ini
# ~/.config/systemd/user/dsh-whale-ruminate.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/node /path/to/dsh-whale-memory/ruminate.js --count 1
```

```ini
# ~/.config/systemd/user/dsh-whale-ruminate.timer
[Timer]
OnBootSec=30min
OnUnitActiveSec=2h
RandomizedDelaySec=30min

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```

```bash
systemctl --user enable --now dsh-whale-ruminate.timer
```

## 配置

| 常量 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `MEMORY_BUDGET_CHARS` | 1600 | 每次注入的记忆字符上限 |
| `RECENT_PAIRS` | 6 | 热区保留的最近交互轮数 |
| `RECALL_MAX` | 3 | 主动联想候选上限 |
| `FACT_MAX` | 8 | 稳定事实条数上限 |
| `COLD_MAX` | 2000 | 冷区硬上限 |
| `IMPORTANT_WEIGHT` | 8 | 权重达到此值不再参与合并 |
| `RECALL_THRESHOLD` | 2.0 | 联想的分数门槛 |

环境变量：

| 变量 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `EMBED_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:8377` | 向量服务地址 |
| `EMBED_PORT` | `8377` | 向量服务监听端口 |
| `WHALE_DB` | `~/.dsh/whale-memory/memory.db` | 记忆库路径（`ruminate.js` 用） |

数据落在 `~/.dsh/whale-memory/memory.db`（SQLite，WAL 模式）。

## 自检

```bash
node test-selfcheck.mjs        # 七个纯函数用例，不需要向量服务
curl http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-whale-memory/status
```

状态端点返回：

```json
{"dbPath":"...","hot":0,"cold":4,"facts":0,"important":0,
 "embedOk":true,"embedUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:8377",
 "stats":{"merged":0,"recalled":1,"ruminated":1},"budgetChars":1600}
```

`embedOk: false` 表示向量服务挂了，插件会自动降级到二元组重叠，功能不中断。

## 已知限制

- **没有真 PG**。SQLite 足够单机场景；多用户并发或多机共享才需要 PG。
- **胡思乱想不是真正的「空闲时」**。它是 timer 每 2 小时跑一次，不是随时随地在想。
- **情绪识别靠词表**，不是模型。隐晦的表达会漏。
- **联想质量取决于记忆量**。冷区只有三四条时，配对出来的念头往往很牵强。
- **向量服务独立于插件**。插件只调 HTTP，服务挂了会降级但不报错。

## 实现上踩过的坑

写这个插件时遇到三个值得记下的问题：

**1. `ctx.get('webServer')` 在 `apply()` 里拿不到服务**

```js
// 错：服务可能还没就绪，拿到 undefined，整块 if 静默跳过
const webServer = ctx.get('webServer')
if (webServer !== undefined) { /* 永远不执行 */ }

// 对：等依赖就绪再回调
ctx.inject(['webServer'], (webCtx) => {
  webCtx.effect(() => webCtx.webServer.register({...}), '...')
})
```

**2. BERT 分词必须逐字切 CJK**

`BertPreTokenizer` 的规则是给每个中日韩字符单独成 token。按空格切词会让整段中文变成 `[UNK]`，向量退化成常量噪声——**相似的无关句子反而得分更高**。

**3. 中文里硬切 n-gram 会切出半截词**

「最近天天加班」用 3~5 字窗口切，会得到「近天天」这种不是词的碎片。做实体抽取时改成**整句取法**（按标点分句，去掉时间/人称前缀）反而更稳。

## 致谢

设计受这几个项目启发：

- [Companion-AI-Memory-Context-Token-Optimization](https://github.com/ARCHEON999/Companion-AI-Memory-Context-Token-Optimization) — 冷热分层与线索唤回的原始设计
- [dsh-layered-memory](https://github.com/JunNanLYS/dsh-layered-memory) — L0~L3 分层蒸馏
- [dsh-mnemon](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon) — 可组合的记忆来源与视图
- [miyu-agent](https://github.com/SHORiN-KiWATA/miyu-agent) — 模型与分词器的来源

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# LoopX for DeepSeek Harness

`dsh-loopx-plugin` is one independently versioned DSH package with three
separate Loader rows:

- the init row automatically installs or upgrades the LoopX CLI, installs the
  packaged workflow skills into `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` (default
  `~/.agents/skills`), and verifies the DSH-native `loopx` entry before DSH
  finishes loading it. `/loopx-init` remains the explicit repair command.
- a passive same-session Driver becomes eligible only after the exact current
  Session successfully invokes the exact `loopx` skill. It then asks LoopX
  whether another turn may run and queues the authoritative heartbeat task
  into that live DSH Agent.
- the package-root Host registers GoalBar at the authenticated
  `/api/loopx.goalbar` route required by DSH 0.1.5. Its web Client adds a compact
  GoalBar between DSH's native GoalBar and Queue dock rows, visible only for one
  exact live `(goalId, loopxAgentId)` binding.

Installing the plugin and starting DSH load and prepare these capabilities;
neither creates a binding nor activates the Driver. The GoalBar
does one bounded read when a browser row mounts, then watches exact-Session
`step/end` and `turn/end` boundaries. It rereads LoopX only when the opaque
revision of the authoritative binding or active Goal state changes; a watch
lease also detects changes written outside that Session. DSH Agent-status
events update an existing row without a LoopX business read. Until one exact
Session contains valid typed `loopx` invocation evidence, its Driver makes no
LoopX CLI, binding, quota, or heartbeat call, creates no timer, and queues no
followup.

The package does not expose LoopX model tools, a binding sidecar, or its own
Goal/Todo state. Models use the installed LoopX skills and call the LoopX CLI
directly. LoopX remains the only authority for Goal, Agent, Todo, quota,
activation, and durable thread-binding data. The GoalBar protocol and its
deferred atomicity limit are specified in the versioned
[DSH native LoopX design](../../docs/plans/2026-08-20-dsh-native-skill-driver.md).

## Install

Requirements are stable Node.js 22.22.3+ (excluding Node.js 23), `pnpm`,
Python 3.11+ with `pip`, and network access for the first DSH start when no
compatible LoopX CLI is already installed. LoopX itself is deliberately not a
prerequisite. The initializer
honors an explicit `PYTHON_BIN`; otherwise it tries `python3`, then discovers
`python3.<minor>` executables on the supplied `PATH` in descending numeric
order, then tries the bare name `python`. The last name is what a python.org
Windows install registers, so it keeps that host reachable when `python3` is
absent or is the `WindowsApps` App Execution Alias that never starts Python.
Unlike the versioned names it is not a `PATH` scan result; it is resolved when
the candidate runs. Installation still checks the Python version and pip;
reopening the managed runtime uses the same discovery and validates the LoopX
CLI. No hard-coded minor-version list is maintained. When selecting Python for
installation, an invalid explicit interpreter fails instead of falling back.
Managed-runtime readback keeps the existing CLI fallback behavior. If the
plugin must install or upgrade LoopX, it writes an isolated
copy under `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/runtime/dsh-loopx-plugin` (default
`~/.agents/runtime/dsh-loopx-plugin`) and never mutates the system Python
environment. This works with externally managed Python distributions that
enforce PEP 668; the plugin does not use `--break-system-packages`.
This version requires LoopX 1.2.4 or newer, the published release that
includes the Windows peer-file fix. Bootstrap, Driver and GoalBar use the same
version floor; an older global or managed CLI is upgraded or rejected before
business commands run. An explicit outdated `LOOPX_BIN` must be upgraded by its
owner. Older plugin releases retain their original CLI requirements.
Install the prebuilt release into the web profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add \
  "https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/releases/download/dsh-loopx-plugin-v0.1.1-beta.6/dsh-loopx-plugin-0.1.1-beta.6.tgz"
```

The beta.6 package targets the qualified DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 API and retains the
qualified frozen 0.1.5 and 0.1.7-rc.2 compatibility ranges. The exported legacy
RPC registration remains available to explicit callers, but plugin startup
always uses the shared API.

The source candidate additionally qualifies DSH 0.2.1-rc.2. Its frozen source
host uses MCP client 2.3.0 and SDK 1.32.0 to address
[GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw).
These dependency overrides do not patch an independently installed DSH binary;
that host's owner must update its affected MCP dependencies separately.

For a compatible DSH source build, use:

```bash
cd packages/dsh-loopx-plugin
./install.sh
```

Start DSH on loopback (port `0` asks the OS for a free port) and open the
printed URL. The plugin finishes its idempotent LoopX CLI and skill bootstrap
before DSH publishes the Web URL through its native Loader readiness boundary.
The source candidate gates only LoopX's Host and Driver on `loopxBootstrap`,
so disabling or uninstalling it keeps the shared Web server and runtime alive.
The published beta.6 limitation is described under automatic initialization:

```bash
dsh --profile web --port 0
```

Use `/loopx <task>` immediately. If automatic initialization reports a safe
failure in the DSH log, fix the named Python or package-manager problem and run
`/loopx-init` once to retry; normal installation does not require that command.

Installation is the GoalBar opt-in: there is no separate remote endpoint or
per-session grant. A row remains hidden until the exact DSH Session has one
unique LoopX binding. After invoking the installed `loopx` skill for that
Session, run the minimum authority readback inside that Session's DSH shell
(or replace `$DSH_SESSION_ID` with the exact Session id):

```bash
loopx --registry .loopx/registry.json --format json \
  resolve-agent-thread \
  --host-surface deepseek-harness-native \
  --thread-id "$DSH_SESSION_ID"
```

`status=bound` with one exact pair admits the row; missing or ambiguous results
fail closed and render nothing. `Start` resumes a stopped Goal and asks the
Driver to evaluate only when that exact live Session already contains typed
`loopx` skill activation evidence. It never activates an inactive Session.
`Pause` stops the Goal and retires only future queued/scheduled continuation;
it does not abort a claimed or running turn.

To start DSH from a terminal with this machine's stored LoopX provider
credential without placing the value in argv, shell history, or output:

```bash
loopx dsh-launch web
```

The launcher uses `DSH_HOME` when set, otherwise
`~/.local/state/loopx/dsh-home`. Ordinary DSH installation defaults to `~/.dsh`;
launching the isolated home does not reuse that home's installed plugins. To
reuse an ordinary installation, select its actual home explicitly:

```bash
loopx dsh-launch --dsh-home "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}" web
```

For a new isolated source installation, use the same home and package-local
host for installation, readback, launch, and removal:

```bash
cd packages/dsh-loopx-plugin
export DSH_HOME="$HOME/.local/state/loopx/dsh-home"
./install.sh
export DSH_BIN="$PWD/node_modules/.bin/dsh"
"$DSH_BIN" --profile web --dump-config
loopx dsh-launch --dsh-bin "$DSH_BIN" web
# When removing this installation:
"$DSH_BIN" plugin --profile web remove dsh-loopx-plugin
```

Use `--dsh-home <path>` to select profile and Session state,
`--dsh-agents-home <path>` to isolate installed skills, and `--dsh-bin <path>`
when `dsh` is not on `PATH`. Arguments after `--` are passed to DSH unchanged.
The launcher resolves the same write-only machine credential used by the
managed executor, then replaces itself with DSH so the credential exists only
in the child process environment.

Maintainers can validate the built and packed surfaces with:

```bash
pnpm build
pnpm smoke:mcp-transport
pnpm smoke:artifact
pnpm smoke:profile
pnpm smoke:runtime
pnpm smoke:docker
```

The runtime smoke creates an isolated temporary DSH profile. Its real web
process proves profile composition, automatic initialization before readiness,
immediate skill-catalog visibility, boot-manifest discovery, bundle serving,
Client materialization, and the loopback Connection fence. A
live-disable probe withdraws the bootstrap provider and all package rows while
checking that DSH stays available and LoopX's route retires; a fresh process
also boots with the whole package disabled. Separately, a
packed supported-DSH Context, Connection, and WebServer with a live Host Session fixture
cover same-turn binding discovery, lease-time source reconciliation,
status-only updates, pending-watch cancellation, successful actions, and
handler disposal through the real HTTP carrier. The served Client is then
applied in DSH's real ClientModuleSystem with a VM document harness; that layer
covers slot order and coexistence, Session injection, and ordinary-unload/HMR
style cleanup, but it is not a browser-mounted React interaction. These layers
do not replace the owner-reviewed packed-browser gate: that separate manual
layer mounts the served Client at a real DSH URL and exercises Client-to-carrier
Start/Pause. Focused Client tests cover Session-generation replacement and old
request cancellation without duplicating that matrix in the packed smoke.
The Docker smoke packs the current plugin and builds the current LoopX
release-candidate wheel, then starts both in a clean Debian container with the
DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 release candidate. It proves PEP 668-compatible private installation,
the managed launcher, startup readiness, installed `loopx` skill files, launch-
token authentication, and an authenticated GoalBar read through DSH's shared
API carrier. It requires Docker, `uv`, and network access for base images and
never opens a browser or configures a model provider.

## Maintainer release and marketplace handoff

A DSH plugin release needs an immutable prebuilt GitHub asset and a qualified
install channel in each marketplace named in its closeout. The
[`awesome-dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
directory and [DSH Plugin Hub](https://github.com/dshplugin/dsh-plugin-hub)
have distinct published catalogs. Current Hub releases read
`https://api.dsh-plugin.org/plugins.en.json` and `plugins.zh.json`; updating
the awesome directory does not update those consumers. Marketplace maintainers
retain authority over their own catalogs.

Pinned GitHub release installation does not require publishing LoopX on npm.
Release-URL installed-state matching shipped in
[Hub 1.5.0](https://github.com/dshplugin/dsh-plugin-hub/releases/tag/v1.5.0).
Qualification must read the actual marketplace's catalog back, select the
pinned package, install it, recognize the installed row, update it and remove
it successfully. The optional npm channel retains its separate account and
trusted-publisher requirements.

For every DSH plugin release:

1. Update the package version and this README's pinned install URL. Run the
   typecheck, tests, and the built, packed, runtime, profile, and Docker smokes
   listed above, plus `pnpm smoke:registry --tarball <packed-package.tgz>`.
   The registry smoke serves the real packed bytes on loopback and invokes
   DSH's unversioned package-name installer; it publishes nothing. CI repeats
   this installation and removal on Linux and Windows.
   Qualification uses pnpm 10.33.0; use that version for reproducible source
   and isolated-registry checks.
2. Prepare complete bilingual GitHub release notes. Run
   `examples/release/release-readiness-doc-smoke.py` with one `--surface` for
   every optional capability changed by the release.
3. Merge the exact reviewed commit, pack from that immutable tag target, and
   publish both the version tag and `dsh-loopx-plugin-<version>.tgz` asset.
4. Read the remote release body back and rerun the release-readiness smoke.
   Download the remote asset and verify that its SHA-256 matches the local
   package before advertising it. For the npm channel, publish that **same
   tarball**, including its compiled Host, Client, Driver and initializer:

   ```bash
   npm whoami
   npm publish ./dsh-loopx-plugin-VERSION.tgz --access public --tag latest
   node scripts/verify-distribution.mjs --tarball ./dsh-loopx-plugin-VERSION.tgz
   ```

   `latest` intentionally names the qualified plugin candidate, because the
   marketplace installs its unversioned npm name. Do not substitute a
   beta-only tag or publish the monorepo root. The readback checks metadata,
   tag, downloaded bytes and the repository search used by DSH Hub. A missing
   package, wrong artifact or search-index delay fails verification; publishing
   alone does not complete marketplace recovery. npm account authentication
   or configured trusted publishing belongs to the release operator.

   For token-free CI publication, configure the package's npm Trusted Publisher
   with organization `loopx-project`, repository `loopx`, and workflow filename
   `dsh-plugin-publish.yml`, permitting `npm publish`. Then dispatch **Publish
   DSH Plugin to npm** on the existing published plugin tag, using that same tag
   for the `release_tag` input. This keeps npm provenance on the artifact's commit.
   The workflow requires a merged tag, consumes its GitHub asset without
   rebuilding, and verifies npm bytes and discovery. It neither creates a
   GitHub release nor replaces npm account ownership or the release guide gate.
5. For the awesome directory, in a clean fork branch of `awesome-dsh-plugin`, update only
   `data/plugins/loopx-project__loopx--packages-dsh-loopx-plugin.yml` to the new
   immutable asset URL. Confirm the URL resolves, then run
   `node scripts/generate-readme.mjs --check` and `git diff --check`.
6. Open the upstream directory pull request and link it from the release
   closeout. Separately verify the installed Hub's catalog source at the
   released Hub revision. Read both language feeds and the website's install
   command; for the LoopX row, check the `ic` and `igc` targets against the
   immutable release URL. Route stale Hub metadata to its existing
   [data-correction issue channel](https://github.com/dshplugin/dsh-plugin-hub/issues).
   Keep that marketplace's adoption open until its actual consumer resolves
   and installs the released package. A merged directory PR, another catalog's
   listing, or an upgraded Hub cannot establish that postcondition.

## Shadow observer (default off)

`src/observer.ts`, exported as `dsh-loopx-plugin/observer`, is the
`dsh-session-events` provider for the LoopX
[Reliability Diagnostics](../../loopx/capabilities/reliability_diagnostics/README.md)
capability: an L1 shadow observer that consumes read-only harness events and
appends compact, public-safe envelopes plus an observer stats record to
`<loopx-runtime-root>/reliability_diagnostics/by-goal/<sha256>.ndjson`, where
`sha256` is the lowercase digest of the exact UTF-8 Goal id. Upgrade the CLI and
plugin together. An existing legacy filename blocks flushes with
`LegacyDiagnosticLedgerError` until the
[offline upgrade](../../loopx/capabilities/reliability_diagnostics/docs/local-retention-v0.md#upgrading-a-legacy-ledger-offline)
preserves its history; readback never silently migrates it. It is a
separate Cordis row and bundle from the Driver, with no Driver or Agent
injection and no shared send path. It never calls `agent.send`, touches the
inbox, invokes the LoopX CLI, schedules, retries, stops, or resumes anything.
Every hook body and every flush is isolated, so an observer failure is counted
into the receipt instead of reaching DSH. This is module and hook isolation,
not an OS-process-isolation claim.

Before its first append, the producer applies the same recursive local-path,
credential-like value, and credential-field guard as the Python contract.
Unsafe event tokens or ids are counted as `public_safety_violation` and never
reach ledger bytes; CLI ingest independently re-validates persisted records.

It is off unless one exact goal, DSH session, and complete run identity are
declared before DSH starts:

```bash
export LOOPX_DSH_SHADOW_OBSERVER_GOAL_ID=<goal-id>
export LOOPX_DSH_SHADOW_OBSERVER_SESSION_ID=<session-id>
export LOOPX_DSH_SHADOW_OBSERVER_RUN_IDENTITY_JSON='{"worker_id":"<worker>","model_id":"<model>","task_id":"<task>","environment_id":"<environment>","tools_id":"<tools>","budget_id":"<budget>","adapter_revision":"<adapter-revision>","observer_revision":"<observer-revision>"}'
# optional: LOOPX_DSH_SHADOW_OBSERVER_LEDGER_DIR, LOOPX_DSH_SHADOW_OBSERVER_BUFFER_BOUND (default 256)
loopx reliability-diagnostics receipt --goal-id <goal-id> --format json
loopx reliability-diagnostics status  --goal-id <goal-id> --format json
```

Unless all required variables are valid, the independent observer row
registers no hook and writes no file. When enabled, it consumes only
`session/created`, `session/event`, and `session/disposed`; it skips the retired
token-level `assistant/chunk` rows older logs still replay, and records tool
names, turn and step numbers, typed end reasons, and ids only, never arguments,
outputs, prompts, or paths. Events for
any session other than the exact configured session are rejected as
`identity_invalid`. The stats record pins worker/model/task/environment/tools/
budget plus adapter and observer revisions, declares source coverage, and
proves count conservation. Sequence gaps, bounded-buffer drops, flush attempts,
declared clock uncertainty, and the empty outbound and influence fields make
the run's admissibility auditable from the receipt.

This is an experimental adapter implementing the RFC's P0 prototype
components. It does not establish the RFC's P0 exit: C0 fidelity, a qualifying
C1 run, and measured observer overhead remain separate evidence gates.

## Optional native operation context (SDK prerequisite)

The independently loaded `dsh-loopx-plugin/native-operation-context` subpath
registers one read-only model tool, `loopx_operation_context`. It is absent from
the default plugin tree and `cordis.patch.yml`; installing the package does not
activate it. An explicit SDK Loader patch can load the built module:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: loopx-native-operation-context
      name: file:///absolute/path/to/dsh-loopx-plugin/lib/native-operation-context.js
```

The tool accepts `{}` only. It derives the calling live session and open Turn
from DSH's agent and session-projection services; caller-supplied identities,
closed Turns, cancelled calls and disposed or shadowed tool registrations fail.
Only provider, model and reasoning-effort options are returned. Other agent
options, including credentials, are excluded. Profile options are observations,
not HTTP wire attestation; `wire_profile_verified` and `execution_allowed` are
always `false`. This module creates no Core actor, grant, binding, approval or
account access, and consumes no approval.

The initial runtime qualification uses the Python SDK and bundled DSH
`0.1.5rc1`: a real native tool call returned the matching SDK session and open
Turn. This does not qualify other DSH versions or the complete managed operation
journey. From a source checkout, build and verify registration using an
interpreter with the selected `deepseek-harness` SDK installed:

```bash
pnpm --dir packages/dsh-loopx-plugin build
"$SDK_PYTHON" packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/smoke/dsh-native-context-sdk-smoke.py \
  --module packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/lib/native-operation-context.js \
  --provider deepseek-official --model deepseek-flash
```

This smoke initializes the real SDK with an isolated temporary home and dummy
credentials, checks the runtime's schema registration, and makes zero model
requests. It does not execute a Turn or test financial operations. Remove the
explicit Loader row to disable the module, then restart the owning SDK runtime;
the default plugin tree remains unchanged. Existing active sessions must be
closed by their owner rather than treated as revoked by editing a patch file.

The read-only module alone delivers no frontend or Lark operation path.

## Optional owned SDK operation connection

`dsh-loopx-plugin/native-operation` is a separate, explicit Loader module for
the internal `OwnedDshOperationHost`. It registers `loopx_operation` with an
absolute, parent-owned Unix socket supplied by the host; it is absent from the
default exports and patch. Installing the package grants no execution access.

The host retains the original SDK stdio connection across separately admitted
Turns. Kernel peer PID, native session/Turn/call ID, exact native arguments and
the observed provider/model/effort must match before dispatch to the existing
Core operation handler. The existing Turn session file and typed operation
store own profile binding, revocation, approval, first consumption and outcome;
there is no second approval store or public actor/proof/consume endpoint.
Changing the module/package JS, model profile or session requires fresh
admission and approval. Transport loss never permits an automatic effect retry.

The real SDK/bundled runtime `0.1.5rc1` qualifies two Turns on one retained
connection with a scripted loopback provider: prepare, reject before approval,
fixture confirmation, inspect, one permitted consumption, rejected repeat and
canonical `not_executed` outcome. Synthetic confirmation is not human approval;
no venue/account effect or paid model call is involved. The read-only real-model
probe above and this integrated synthetic-provider test prove different stages.

SDK `0.1.5rc1` cannot reload persisted sessions (`session already exists`);
a new host still refuses that version's resume before runtime launch.
An isolated candidate uses Python SDK `0.2.1a3`, built with the official wheel
script from [upstream source `2fbf4359`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/2fbf4359b82fb94c03dcce0b831660d87f12ea5c),
and an explicit `runtime_bin` pointing to npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.3`.
The SDK's public `resume_session` restores the same persisted identity without
sending input. The host pins SDK files, the executable/Node and complete npm
closure into the immutable profile; changes require fresh admission/approval.
File/SQLite tests close the first process, restore the original session and
repeat the operation sequence. Missing or unreadable history refuses without
a provider call, replacement binding or reusable failed client. This candidate
does not qualify the default plugin's peer range or a published Python release.

Public CLI/delegation activation, frontend/Lark original-card return and actual
financial execution remain unqualified. The public managed-operation preflight
remains Codex-only until those entry points are integrated. Disable by omitting this explicit
module and closing its owned host; do not interpret patch removal as revoking
an already running process.

## GoalBar authority and privacy boundary

The GoalBar carrier uses Connection's authenticated `/api/loopx.goalbar`
Fetch route. Explicit callers of the deprecated RPC registration can still
register `/loopx`; plugin startup does not select it automatically. Both pass
Connection's Host/Origin trust fence and browser authentication, and this
package adds no second credential of its own. The deployment's reachability
policy — loopback by default, or declared `trustedHosts` — decides which
browsers can reach the host at all; Phase 1 does not support LAN or remote
browsers. The browser supplies only its injected DSH Session id and, for an
action, the last validated Goal/Agent pair. The Host re-derives cwd and thread
identity from the live DSH Agent, freshly resolves the binding, and executes
only fixed LoopX argv.

The wire allowlist contains ids, activation, live Agent status, full-lane
counts, cursors, opaque source revisions, and fixed error codes. It excludes
Todo text, Goal objective, quota, evidence, CLI output, exception messages,
registry paths, credentials, and binding candidates. A source revision is only
a change token, not authorization or a compare-and-swap guard. Installing the
package grants no model tool authority, does not create or repair bindings, and
does not change LoopX core state by itself.

## Automatic initialization and `/loopx-init` repair

When DSH loads the plugin, the init row runs the same typed initialization
routine and publishes the `loopxBootstrap` readiness service only after it
settles. DSH's native Loader wait keeps the printed URL behind initialization;
the service is a dependency only of LoopX's Host and Driver. A safe failure is
logged without raw subprocess output or local paths and leaves `/loopx-init`
registered for an explicit retry. Disabling the package leaves LoopX's
rows unavailable while DSH remains usable. Removing the package's
rows releases its routes without stopping the shared Web server or runtime.
Automatic startup does not create Agent followups or model calls.

The host-isolation repair in this source is pending a new plugin release.
Published beta.6 still adds the shared Web dependency and can disconnect DSH
during hot uninstall, including with Hub 1.6.4. For that published package,
close DSH, remove it with the native plugin CLI, then restart DSH.

The repair command has no arguments. Extra input returns a usage error before any
model work or CLI probe. A valid invocation queues a bounded start followup on
the exact receiving Agent, then probes the current LoopX installation. When the
CLI is missing or lacks the DSH-native skill contract, it runs exactly one
fixed-argv `pip install --upgrade --target <plugin-runtime> 'loopx>=1.2.4'`, writes a
small managed Python launcher beside that target, then uses that same
interpreter and launcher to install and read back the skills. Driver and
GoalBar resolve this same managed runtime, including after an explicit repair.
It never constructs a shell command, mutates the system Python environment,
edits a registry, or retries the install mutation.

Unless the command is cancelled, it queues a second bounded followup for the
typed success or failure result. These are ordinary Agent turns, so a valid,
uncancelled invocation normally adds two model calls; cancellation leaves only
the already queued start turn, while invalid input adds none. The prompts do
not authorize tools, commands, or another installation. Followup delivery is
best effort and is not retried. The native `CommandResult` rendered by the
command UI remains authoritative: a followup failure or model reply cannot
change the installation result or repeat its mutation.

On success, DSH's filesystem skill provider invalidates its catalog and loads
created or updated skills without a restart. Missing or unknown skill status
still fails initialization instead of being guessed as unchanged.

After initialization, invoke the `loopx` skill with the task text. The skill
uses the exact DSH-managed `$DSH_SESSION_ID`, passes
`--host-surface deepseek-harness-native`, and follows the typed commands
returned by LoopX. The historical external connector remains the distinct
`deepseek-harness` / `dsh` surface.

## Driver activation boundary

Activation is per Session, not per plugin, process, Agent, Goal, or project.
The Driver accepts only either of these durable typed Session facts:

- a `user/message` whose source is exactly `skill-invocation`, whose name is
  exactly `loopx`, and whose form is exactly `instructions`;
- a model `tool/call` named exactly `skill`, with JSON object arguments whose
  `name` is exactly `loopx`, paired by call id with a subsequent successful
  `tool/result`.

A skill catalog, ordinary prose, shell text, `/loopx-init`, plugin-authored
init or heartbeat messages, a failed, malformed, unmatched, or superseded
model call, and the presence of a CLI, registry, Goal, binding, or project file
do not activate the Driver. Recovery folds only the current Session's existing
typed event history in memory and performs no external probe. Replacing or
clearing a Session recomputes from the replacement history; activation never
inherits across that boundary and has no plugin-owned durable store.

Existing Sessions upgraded from an older plugin version remain inactive when
their retained history has no recognizable invocation evidence. Invoke the
installed `loopx` skill once in every Session that should continue
automatically. Activation records intent only: it does not create a binding,
select a Goal or Agent, spend quota, or grant tool authority. After activation,
the existing exact binding, fresh quota, scheduler/heartbeat, reservation, and
pre-step revalidation order remains authoritative.

## Driver retry boundary

DSH's LLM retry plugin owns provider-request retries. This Driver retries only
safe fixed-argv LoopX reads and an idempotent `quota should-run` receipt, at
most twice beyond the first attempt. Every retry uses the same
`--turn-instance-id`. Typed authority denials, incompatible schemas,
cancellation, and human input are never retried. There is no cumulative
eight-failure breaker or plugin-owned durable activation state. The small
process-local activation projection is bound to one exact Session and is
reconstructed only from its typed event history. Exhausting the three attempts
stops that evaluation; it does not create a periodic error-retry loop. Only a
typed LoopX local-scheduler plan can schedule another wakeup, and its limit on
unchanged polls is enforced.

For an admitted automatic continuation, that exact turn id is also carried in
the LoopX-owned canonical heartbeat body and the typed DSH continuation source.
The source is attribution for reservation matching, not authority. Before work
enters a model step, the Driver replays the same receipt and the LoopX guard
returns the typed settlement plan for that exact id. Accountable

# dsh-archive-favorites-forge

**Favourites, copy id+path, per-session delete, idle batch archive, a favourites
filter, and edit-resend / undo-turn with automatic file rollback for DeepSeek
Harness conversations** — additive slot extensions over the shipped archive
feature. It edits **no official file**.

**给 DSH 的对话加上收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条删除、超时批量归档、收藏筛选，以及「编辑重发 / 撤销整轮 + 文件自动快照回滚」 —— 全部挂在官方插槽上，不改官方一行代码。**

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm-dsh--archive--favorites--forge-cb3837?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-archive-favorites-forge)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A5%200.2.0--rc.2-4f46e5)](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-archive-favorites-forge)

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

---

## Screenshots

**1. The conversation menu** — four rows added to the shipped 「…」 menu: favourite, copy id + path, continue in a new window, and a guarded delete. The harness's own duplicate 「复制 Session ID」 row is hidden:

![Session menu](assets/01-session-menu.png)

**2. The favourites filter** — two extra rows in the official 筛选会话 group, narrowing the sidebar to favourites that are archived and to favourites that are not:

![Favourites filter](assets/02-favourites-filter.png)

**3. The settings panel** — idle batch archive, the favourites list with archive state, and batch delete of archived conversations that are not favourites:

![Settings panel](assets/03-settings-panel.png)

**4. The per-turn buttons** — 复制 → ↺ undo → ✏️ edit-and-resend → 🗑 delete under every human message, including the messages you interject mid-turn:

## Why this exists

DSH already ships an archive feature: the Workspace registry keeps a global
`archivedSessionIds` set and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` renders the
sidebar rows plus a view-options filter. That shipped feature has **no
favourites, no per-conversation delete, no copy-id/path affordance, and no
time-based batch archive** — and it deliberately refuses to open an archived
conversation. The transcript has **no per-message edit or undo** either, and
nothing in the harness rolls back the files an assistant turn rewrote. The
sidebar's "Ungrouped" bucket has **no explanation and no repair entry point**.

This plugin adds those things by attaching to documented official slot points,
so it composes with the shipped UI instead of patching it.
